title: Automation & AI Operations Specialist | Make.com · Airtable
description:
?? THIS ROLE REQUIRES A WRITTEN PRE-SCREEN, A 75-MINUTE RECORDED TECHNICAL TEST, AND AN INTERVIEW. ALL STEPS ARE MANDATORY. IF ANY OF THESE IS A PROBLEM FOR YOU, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.




 & AIRTABLE AUTOMATION SPECIALIST

Australian-based online Company · Australia · Remote



We test for real execution. If 
 is not your strongest tool — the one you reach for first, the one you can debug blindfolded — this role will be frustrating for you. The technical test will make that clear quickly.



THE ROLE

You execute. You fix what's broken, automate what's manual, and ship working solutions — not proposals. From day one, you resolve active automation friction across our business lines using 
 and Airtable. In parallel, you will be trained by an external specialist on our proprietary AI agent infrastructure and progressively take full ownership of it.

This is not a design or consulting role. If you need perfect requirements before you move, this isn't for you.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Automation Execution — Identify, build, and maintain automations for key operational processes using 
 and Airtable. Every solution ships with documentation and a measurable impact: time saved, errors eliminated, cost reduced.

Systems Integration — Connect forms, databases,
, and reporting tools. Keep every solution scalable and maintainable by someone other than you.

AI Agent Operations (Phase 2) — Operate and monitor 9 active AI agents across the group. Once onboarding is complete, build new agents without external supervision.

Documentation — Every automation and agent documented clearly enough for another technician to operate it without asking you questions.

Weekly Reporting — Direct report to founder. Working language: English.





STACK

Required:




 — primary automation tool

Airtable — operational database

Google Workspace — Gmail, Forms, Sheets integrations

OpenAI / Claude / Gemini APIs — AI agents (Phase 2, trained on the job)



Nice to have:



WordPress — primary web platform for landing pages and web properties

WooCommerce

Gravity Forms

Lovable (AI web builder)

Hostinger — hosting and domain management

Stripe — payment integration

Newsletter plugins for WordPress

DNS configuration and domain activation

Plugin integration and connectivity across web properties

Basic frontend / backend knowledge





FIRST 90 DAYS — WHAT WE MEASURE



At least 35% of active operational bottlenecks resolved with automations live in production

100% of existing and new automations documented with clear SOPs

Full operational independence from current external IT provider

AI agent infrastructure fully learned and operating independently

Weekly impact report delivered without exception: hours saved, errors eliminated, workflows shipped





ONGOING KPIs — POST 90 DAYS



Uptime: all critical 
 scenarios running — zero unmonitored failures

On-call response: when a critical automation goes down, you respond immediately and resolve it — day or night

Delivery: new automations in production each quarter, target agreed with founder

Documentation: every automation documented before closing any sprint or delivery



On-call note: This role is on-call. If a critical automation goes down outside business hours, we expect you to respond and resolve it. This doesn't happen daily — but when it does, it needs to be fixed fast. The robustness of what you build determines how often this happens. Build well, sleep well.



WHO YOU ARE



You figure things out. When you hit a wall, you go around it — you don't wait for someone to move it.

You've built 
 automations that actually run in production, not just in demos.

You can read someone else's broken scenario, identify the problem, and fix it without documentation.

You're comfortable with a new tool or API you've never seen and can ship something functional the same day.

You take ownership. If something breaks at 2am, you fix it at 2am.





COMPENSATION

Base salary: AUD $1,800–$2,200/month. Final figure within that range is determined by your performance in the technical test — not your CV, not your years of experience.

KPI bonus: 20?ditional compensation paid quarterly when KPIs are met.

What determines your pay: what you can actually do, demonstrated in the test.



SELECTION PROCESS

Three steps. All are mandatory.

Step 1 — Written pre-screen: before anything else, you answer 4 short questions by
. No right or wrong answers — we want to know who you are and confirm you've read and accepted the conditions of this role.

Step 2 — Live Technical Test (75 min, recorded): a hands-on execution test using 
 and Airtable. You record your full screen from start to finish. Submissions without a recording are not evaluated. The test is designed so that no one finishes everything — what we measure is quality, judgment under pressure, and how far you get.

Step 3 — Interview (45 min): only the top 3 candidates reach this stage. A final conversation with the founder before the decision is made.

If any step is a problem for you, this role is not a fit.

title: 3D Artist Virtual Assistant
description:
Job Title: 3D Blender Specialist / 3D Artist Virtual Assistant



We are looking for a talented and reliable 3D Blender Specialist / 3D Artist Virtual Assistant based in the Philippines to support our creative production team remotely.



About Us — Kleidereisen

Kleidereisen is a German-based furniture, fast-growing creative and e-commerce brand. We work with digital visuals, product presentations, online marketing, and brand content.

Our team works fully remote with clear structures, transparent communication, and organized workflows. We are looking for long-term tea
mbers who want to grow with us and become an important part of our creative production process.



How We Work

Our work process is structured, transparent, and remote-friendly.



We use:

TimeDoctor for time tracking and productivity transparency


 for task management, project planning, deadlines, and workflows

WhatsApp for quick communication, updates, and urgent questions

Microsoft Teams & SharePoint for meetings, files, and collaboration



Experience with these tools is helpful but not required. The tools can be taught.

You will receive clear tasks, deadlines, and creative instructions. We expect regular communication, reliable availability, and professional handling of assigned projects.



What We Offer

Remote position

Part-time or full-time possible

Long-term collaboration preferred

Flexible working hours depending on project needs

Clear tasks, structured workflows, and regular feedback

Opportunity to grow with a creative e-commerce team



Your main tasks will include:

Creating high-quality 3D images, product renders, scenes, and visual assets in Blender for website and paid ads

Producing short 3D animations and videos when needed

Modeling, texturing, lighting, and rendering 3D objects and environments

Editing and enhancing images using Photoshop and Lightroom

Preparing visuals for websites, social media, advertising, and product presentations

Following creative briefs and brand guidelines



Required Tool Skills

Strong experience with Blender

Ability to create realistic and appealing 3D images and videos

Good understanding of lighting, materials, textures, camera angles, and rendering

Experience with Photoshop

Experience with Lightroom

Creative eye for detail, composition, and visual quality



Nice to have:

Experience with realistic product visualization

Experience creating visuals for e-commerce furnitur

Basic video editing skills

Experience with AI image tools or other design software



Required Personal Skills

We are looking for someone who is not only technically skilled, but also professional, reliable, and easy to work with.

Important personal qualities include:



High sense of responsibility

Reliable and consistent work attitude

Good English communication skills

Ability to follow instructions carefully

Openness to feedback and revisions

Willingness to learn and improve

Problem-solving mindset

Ability to work independently

Good time management

Ability to stay organized in a remote work environment

Honest and transparent communication



Required Hardware

Because this role involves 3D rendering, animation, and image editing, a reliable work setup is required.



You should have:

A computer capable of running Blender smoothly

Hardware suitable for 3D rendering and image editing

Reliable internet connection

A UPS in case of a power interruption

Stable remote work environment

Webcam and microphone for online meetings



Please include your PC specifications and internet connection details in your application.

Applications



Please apply only if you can provide a portfolio or samples of previous Blender work.



In your application, please include:

A short introduction about yourself

Your Blender experience

Examples of 3D images, renders, or videos you have created

Your experience with Photoshop and Lightroom

Your hourly rate or monthly salary expectation

Your availability and preferred working hours

Your PC specifications

Your internet connection details



Assessment Center

Before joining our team, every candidate must complete an Assessment Center.

The Assessment Center helps us evaluate your technical skills, creativity, reliability, communication, and ability to follow instructions. After reviewing applications, we will invite selected candidates to complete an assessment task.



The process may include:

A short interview

A practical Blender test task

Review of your Photoshop and Lightroom skills

Evaluation of your communication and responsiveness

Assessment of your ability to work with deadlines and feedback



Only candidates who successfully complete the Assessment Center will be considered for the position.



We are looking for someone creative, detail-oriented, reliable, and motivated to grow with our young team.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
About the Role

-We are looking for a detail-oriented Salesforce Administrator to help support, maintain, and improve our Salesforce environment.

-This is a hands-on offshore role for someone who is comfortable working independently, following requirements carefully, and delivering clean, reliable Salesforce configuration work.

-The ideal candidate has strong Salesforce Admin experience, understands business processes, and can work with U.S.-based teams across operations, intake, recruiting, billing, and leadership.





Core Responsibilities:

-Manage day-to-day Salesforce administration, including users, profiles, permission sets, roles, queues, reports, dashboards, fields, page layouts, record types, flows, and validation rules.

-Create and update reports and dashboards for business teams and leadership.

-Support data cleanup, imports, exports, deduplication, and quality control.

-Troubleshoot Salesforce issues reported by users and identify root causes.

-Document configuration changes, processes, and support steps clearly.

-Work with internal stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into Salesforce solutions.

-Test changes thoroughly before release.

-Support integrations and connected tools where applicable.

-Help improve existing Salesforce processes for efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.



Required Qualifications:

-1+ years of hands-on Salesforce Administrator experience.

-Strong understanding of Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, permissions, sharing, reports, dashboards, and automation.

-Experience troubleshooting Salesforce Flows.

-Comfortable working with data imports, exports, updates, and cleanup.

-Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into Salesforce configuration.

-Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions carefully.

-Good written English communication skills.

-Ability to work independently in an offshore/remote environment.

-Reliable availability for overlap with U.S. business hours.



Preferred Qualifications:

-Salesforce Administrator Certification.

-Experience with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, or Health Cloud.

-Basic understanding of Apex, SOQL, or developer handoff requirements.

-Experience supporting healthcare, ABA, recruiting, intake, billing, or operations teams.

-Experience working in a fast-moving startup or growth-stage company.



What We’re Looking For

-We are looking for someone who is practical, careful, and execution-focused.

-This role is not just ticket-taking. We want someone who can understand the problem, ask good questions when needed, and build clean Salesforce solutions that are easy to maintain.

-The right candidate will be comfortable working through a queue of admin requests, fixing issues quickly, and helping improve our Salesforce setup over time.

title: AI Automation Engineer (Full-Time) — Python, AI Agents & Claude Code | Build Accuracy-Critical Systems
description:
I'm looking for a full-time AI Automation Engineer to help lead and improve the AI systems and automations that run my business — the tools that replace manual work and need to be right, every time.



This is not a no-code "connect two apps in Zapier" role, and it's not a general VA role. I already run automations; I need someone who can take ownership, improve them, and build new agent-driven systems that are reliable enough to trust with real decisions. If your background is GoHighLevel funnels and social-media VA work, this won't be a fit — and that's fine.



What you'll do





Build and improve AI agents and automations that take over repetitive work my team currently does by hand

Write and maintain real code (Python primarily) — not just no-code workflows

Integrate LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, etc.) into production systems: prompting, tool-use/agents, structured outputs, RAG where it fits

Connect our tools via APIs (Shopify, ClickUp, Google Workspace and others) with proper error handling

Make it accurate — build checks, tests and evals so the systems don't quietly make mistakes. This is the part I care about most.

Use modern AI dev tooling (Claude Code, etc.) to ship faster without dropping quality





You must have





Real software engineering ability — comfortable in Python, Git and the command line

Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs and/or agent frameworks (not just chatting with ChatGPT)

Experience automating real workflows end-to-end (n8n, API integrations, custom scripts)

A genuine testing/accuracy mindset — you can explain how you make sure your work is correct

Clear written English and the ability to work independently

A link to your GitHub or a portfolio of things you've actually built





Nice to have





Claude Code / MCP servers, FastAPI, vector databases (Qdrant, pgvector, Pinecone)

Experience replacing manual/VA processes with automation

E-commerce or operations background





Logistics





Full-time, long-term. Fully remote.

A few hours of daily overlap with European time (UTC+3) preferred.

Starts with a short paid trial task before we commit to full-time.







How to apply (read carefully — this is part of the test)





Start your reply with the word ACCURATE so I know you read the whole post. Applications without it will be deleted unread.

Include a link to your GitHub or portfolio — I want to see real work, not just a profile.

Answer these two questions briefly:



Tell me about a system you built where getting it right mattered. How did you make sure it was correct, and how did you handle the cases where it could fail?

If you joined and could automate one repetitive business process first, how would you approach it — and how would you prove it's working accurately?







Confirm your monthly rate, your availability (full-time?), and your timezone overlap.





I read every application that follows these steps. I move quickly for the right person.

title: AI Implementer / Automation Specialist — Build AI Systems for a Growing Business (Marketing Focus)
description:
**Applications that skip this step will be ignored.**



To apply, start your message with the word **"AUTOMATE"** in all caps as the first word. Then answer these three questions in your reply:



1. What is one AI automation you have personally built end-to-end? Describe the problem, the tools you used, and the outcome.

2. Which LLMs and automation platforms are you most comfortable with, and why?

3. If a business owner asked you to "automate our marketing," what would be the first three questions you'd ask them before writing a single workflow?



Applications without the keyword or without answers to all three questions will be discarded.



---



**About the Role**



I'm a business operator looking to bring on someone who can help me design, build, and implement AI-powered automations and tools across the business. The goal is simple: make the business run smoother, cut manual work, and let the team focus on higher-leverage activities. The heaviest area of focus will be **marketing**, but the role will touch operations, customer communications, content, and internal reporting as well.



This is not a role for someone who has only watched YouTube tutorials. I need someone who has actually built things, broken things, fixed them, and shipped working systems.



---



**What You'll Be Doing**



You'll work directly with me to identify manual processes, then design and build the automations that replace them. Example projects include:



- Content generation and repurposing pipelines (turn one long-form piece into blog posts,
 sequences, social captions, and short-form video scripts)

- Automated lead research, enrichment, and personalized outreach at scale

- AI-powered customer segmentation and behavior-triggered campaigns

- Internal marketing dashboards and reporting agents that pull data from multiple sources and summarize it in plain English

- Customer support triage and first-response drafting using LLMs

- SEO and keyword research automations

- Social media scheduling, monitoring, and response workflows

- Internal knowledge base agents that answer team questions from company documentation

- Sales pipeline automations (lead scoring, follow-up sequencing, CRM data hygiene)

- Custom AI tools built with API calls (OpenAI, Anthropic, and others) chained into real business workflows



You will not just be a "prompt writer." You'll be architecting real systems that connect tools, move data, and make decisions.



---



**What You Need to Bring**



- Strong working knowledge of LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, open-source models) and how to use them via API and in no-code platforms

- Solid experience with **n8n** (this is a must — most builds will happen here)

- Comfort with other automation and workflow platforms (Zapier, Make, or similar)

- Understanding of prompt engineering and how to design prompts that produce reliable, structured output

- Basic ability to read and modify Python or JavaScript when a no-code tool hits a wall

- Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, and how data moves between systems

- Ability to work with vector databases, embeddings, and RAG concepts when the project calls for it

- Experience integrating at least a few common business tools (CRMs,
 platforms, spreadsheets, analytics, CMSs, etc.)

- Clear written English — you'll be documenting what you build so the team can maintain it



---



**What Will Make You Stand Out**



- You've built something you're proud of and can walk me through how it works

- You think about reliability and error handling, not just "does it run once"

- You catch problems in a workflow before I do

- You push back when I ask for something that's the wrong approach, and suggest a better one

- You're curious about new AI tools and actually test them, not just read about them



---



**Work Setup**



- Fully remote

- Part-time to start, scaling to full-time based on output and business need

- You'll work directly with me — no bureaucracy, no committees

- Clear scope, clear deliverables, direct feedback



---



**How to Apply**



Follow the instructions at the top of this post. Include links to anything you've built (Loom walkthroughs, GitHub, workflow screenshots, case studies — whatever you have). If you have a portfolio of automations, share it.



Serious applicants only. If you can build, you'll know within the first week whether this is a fit.

title: Sales Cold Caller – High-End Commercial Furniture for Hotels & Resorts
description:
We are a high-end international commercial furniture company serving hotels, resorts, hospitality groups, interior designers, developers, procurement teams, and similar commercial clients. We are looking for a motivated and highly organized Sales Cold Caller to help generate qualified sales opportunities through high-volume outbound calling.



This is a commission-only position, but the commission structure is strong and offers high earning potential for the right person. Your main role will be to make outbound calls, identify interested prospects, gather basic information, and route qualified closing opportunities to our internal closers. There is VERY high earning potential for the right person. 



This position is best suited for someone who is almost fluent in English, comfortable speaking professionally with business contacts, and able to make a high volume of calls each week.



Responsibilities



Make high-volume outbound calls to hotels, resorts, hospitality companies, interior designers, purchasing departments, procurement teams, developers, and related businesses.



Introduce our company and commercial furniture offerings in a professional and polished manner.



Identify potential buyers, decision-makers, upcoming projects, renovation needs, and furniture purchasing timelines.



Qualify interested prospects and gather key information before passing opportunities to the closing team.



Route serious sales opportunities and closing calls to designated closers.



Maintain organized notes, call records, lead status updates, and follow-up reminders.



Work during business hours across multiple U.S. time zones.



Follow scripts, improve messaging, and provide feedback on what prospects are saying.



Requirements



Must be almost fluent in English with a clear, professional phone voice.



Previous cold calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, lead generation, or B2B sales experience preferred.



Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls every week.



Must have a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a quiet work environment.



Must be willing to work U.S. business hours across multiple time zones.



Must be confident speaking with business professionals, gatekeepers, managers, and decision-makers.



Highly organized, self-motivated, and able to work independently.



Must be comfortable qualifying leads and transferring or scheduling interested prospects for a closer.



Experience calling hotels, resorts, interior designers, furniture buyers, real estate developers, construction companies, or commercial businesses is a plus.



Compensation



This is a commission-only position with high commission potential.



There is no base salary, but successful callers can earn strong commissions by generating qualified opportunities that lead to closed sales.



This is a great fit for someone who is confident in outbound calling, motivated by performance-based pay, and willing to make consistent calls every week.



Ideal Candidate



We are seeking multiple candidates for this roll. 



The ideal candidate is professional, persistent, reliable, and organized. You should be comfortable hearing “no,” continuing to make calls, and identifying which prospects are worth escalating to a closer.



You do not need to close the final sale yourself. Your primary responsibility is to generate interest, qualify the opportunity, and route serious prospects to our closing team.

Your availability to work U.S. business hours

Any experience you have calling businesses, hotels, resorts, designers, furniture companies, construction companies, or commercial clients

title: Amazon Private Label Product Research, Sourcing and Launch Specialist / Operations Lead

Position: Amazon Private Label Product Research, Sourcing & Launch Specialist / Operations Lead



Type: Part-Time or Full-Time, Remote/Hybrid (Philippines)



Compensation: PHP 30,000 - 60,000 / month full-time equivalent, depending on level, experience, and proven Amazon Private Label capability. Specialist level: PHP 30,000 - 45,000 / month. Lead level: PHP 45,000 - 60,000 / month. Part-time compensation will be prorated based on agreed weekly hours.



Schedule: Full-time PH daytime hours or fixed part-time blocks, with flexibility for China supplier and Amazon-related communication.





About Our Company:



We are a Canadian corporation specialized in international trade and e-commerce. We operate in the global market and use ecommerce platforms such as Amazon to develop new brands and products for international customers. Our company values professionalism, data-driven decision-making, ownership, and long-term partnerships. We are building a strong, world-class team in the Philippines.





Role Overview:



We are hiring for this function across two levels: Amazon Private Label Specialist and Amazon Private Label Operations Lead. Both levels support our end-to-end Amazon private label operation, with the final level based on the candidate’s experience, judgment, ownership, and ability to work independently.



This is a hands-on Amazon Private Label role covering the full operation from product research and market analysis through supplier sourcing, product development, listing preparation, launch support, inventory and shipment coordination, Seller Central follow-up, post-launch monitoring, reporting, and ongoing process improvement.



Specialist-level candidates should be able to independently execute Amazon private label product research, supplier sourcing, competitor analysis, review analysis, listing support, launch preparation, and Amazon operations with strong accuracy, clear reporting, and good judgment. The specialist should be comfortable using SOPs and templates, but should not rely on step-by-step supervision for every task.



Lead-level candidates should be able to take ownership of Amazon private label opportunities end-to-end, including product research, sourcing direction, product improvement, supplier evaluation, launch planning, Amazon operations, and post-launch monitoring. The lead should be able to review work critically, guide execution quality, improve SOPs/templates, identify risks early, and make practical business recommendations with less supervision.



Candidates should have hands-on Amazon Private Label experience. General e-commerce, Shopify, dropshipping, social media, or basic Amazon VA experience is helpful only if it includes direct Amazon Private Label work.





Key Responsibilities:



•	Conduct or lead Amazon product research using Helium 10, Keepa, Amazon search, Amazon Seller Central data, and other available Amazon research tools.

•	Evaluate product opportunities using demand, pricing, competition, reviews, profitability, keyword opportunity, launch difficulty, differentiation potential, and operational risk.

•	Prepare clear product recommendations and explain the reasoning in a practical business-focused way.

•	Source and communicate with suppliers through Alibaba, 1688, Global Sources, and other sourcing platforms.

•	Request and compare supplier quotes, MOQ, lead time, sample cost, customization options, packaging options, compliance details, shipping details, and product improvement options.

•	Identify product improvement opportunities through review mining, competitor analysis, listing analysis, market gaps, customer complaints, and supplier capability checks.

•	Support product development by turning market findings, supplier options, and customer feedback into practical product specifications and improvement ideas.

•	Support or guide listing preparation, including keyword research, positioning, title and bullet inputs, image direction, A+ content inputs, competitor listing review, and product positioning.

•	Support launch preparation, including listing readiness, inventory planning, shipment coordination, sample follow-up, launch planning, missing-item follow-up, and blocker resolution.

•	Coordinate with designers, copywriters, PPC specialists, suppliers, prep centers, freight forwarders, or other contractors when needed.

•	Monitor Amazon Seller Central issues such as listing status, account health, suppressed listings, inventory status, customer feedback, returns, and operational risks.

•	Monitor post-launch performance, including sales, keyword movement, conversion signals, customer reviews, returns, stock level, pricing, PPC coordination, and competitor activity.

mbers when needed.

, or similar.

What you get when you go full-time (after a 1 to 2 month probation):

We genuinely take care of our team.

description:
Finance & Accounting Manager (Shopify E-commerce)

About Us:

We are a high-revenue Shopify dropshipping company managing 10 webshops and generating millions in revenue across multiple currencies. Our stores operate internationally, processing payments through Stripe and Shopify Payments, while working closely with a Chinese supplier agent for daily order fulfillment and product pricing.

1. Your Responsibilities:

- Financial Reporting: Prepare monthly P&L statements, revenue breakdowns, and cost analysis in QuickBooks Online (QBO).

- Supplier Cost Verification: Cross-check daily product pricing from our Chinese agent before approving payments.

- Expense Management: Track and categorize expenses via A2x or LinkMyBooks, including supplier and operational costs.

- Multi-Currency Handling: Manage USD, EUR, SEK, and other currency transactions, applying accurate exchange rates and tracking FX fees.

- Supplier & Logistics Payments: Process payments to our Chinese agent, verifying pricing, volume discounts, and delivery fees.

- Contractor & Payroll Management: Handle team payouts and contractor salaries.

- Cost Optimization: Identify ways to improve profitability by analyzing supplier costs and payment processing fees.

- Financial Auditing: Conduct regular checks on financial transactions for accuracy and compliance.

- Automation & Tech Stack: Utilize tools like QBO, A2X, LinkmyBooks, Stripe, and Shopify to streamline financial operations.





2. Requirements:

- Proven experience in e-commerce finance management (Shopify & Stripe required).

- Expertise in QBO for bookkeeping, reconciliation, and financial reporting.

- Experience with A2X or LinkmyBooks for expense and revenue tracking.

- Understanding of Chinese supplier operations, including daily price verification and invoice reconciliation.

- Strong knowledge of multi-currency accounting and international payment reconciliation.

- Analytical mindset with great attention to detail for verifying pricing and expenses.

- Fluent English communication skills to collaborate with suppliers and the team.

- Previous experience handling high-volume e-commerce transactions (7-8 figures).





3. What We Offer:

- Competitive salary: $3- $9/hour (Experience/grow-Based) (We work with Hubstaff)

- Fully remote position

- Flexible working hours (with availability for urgent finance matters)

- Long-term position with opportunities to grow into leadership roles

- Join a fast-growing international team with a winning mindset



4. How to Apply:

- Submit your CV and a short cover letter explaining your experience in:

Shopify finance management

QBO (or similar accounting software)

Stripe & Shopify Payments reconciliation

Working with Chinese suppliers

Multi-currency handling

The more details you provide (past experience, testimonials, relevant tools you've used), the better we can assess your fit.

title: Supply Chain & Inventory Specialist
description:
Do you want to be part of a fast-paced, young and entrepreneurial business? Velocity Commerce was born in Cambridge, UK in 2012 and has grown into an award-winning business working across Amazon marketplace growth and the home audio retail sector.



Whether we are developing Amazon marketplace strategies or launching new products across our audio range, we work in a fast-moving, commercially focused environment where ideas are welcome, ownership is encouraged, and performance matters.



We are looking for a sharp, highly organised, and detail-driven Supply Chain & Inventory Operations Specialist to support key procurement, inventory, reporting, and operational processes across our e-commerce and retail channels in the UK, EU, and US.

? Experience in inventory management, supply chain, procurement support, or operational reporting

? Strong analytical skills and confidence working with spreadsheets, reports, and stock data

? 
 experience - training will be provided (we upload POs to a

VSL ads (primary) — long-form

 for

Pacing control — slowing emotional beats, not rushing transformation 
nts

title: Amazon FBM/FBA Virtual Assistant
description:
# Amazon FBA Virtual Assistant



We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Amazon FBA Virtual Assistant to help manage and grow our Amazon business. The ideal candidate will play a key role in identifying profitable products, sourcing inventory, managing listings, monitoring account health, and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations. This is a long-term opportunity for someone who is committed to delivering quality work and helping scale an e-commerce business.



## Expected Outcomes



Your primary goal is to help grow our Amazon FBA business while maintaining a healthy seller account. You will be responsible for:



* Conducting profitable product research using approved sourcing methods.

* Identifying products with strong ROI, low competition, and consistent sales.

* Finding products that are eligible for sale (ungated) or providing documentation for ungating opportunities.

* Creating and optimizing Amazon product listings when required.

* Managing inventory levels and restock recommendations.

* Processing purchases from suppliers and preparing inventory for Amazon FBA shipments.

* Monitoring listing performance, Buy Box status, pricing, and competitors.

* Tracking orders, shipments, reimbursements, and customer issues.

* Maintaining accurate spreadsheets and daily/weekly reports.

* Monitoring Amazon Account Health and ensuring compliance with all Amazon policies.

* Reporting opportunities, risks, and recommendations to improve sales and profitability.



## Skills & Knowledge Required



* Experience managing Amazon Seller Central accounts.

* Strong understanding of Amazon FBA and Online Arbitrage (OA).

* Product sourcing experience using tools such as Keepa, SellerAmp SAS, RevSeller, BuyBotPro, Tactical Arbitrage, or similar.

* Ability to analyze profitability, ROI, sales rank, fees, and competition.

* Familiarity with Amazon policies and best practices.

* Excellent research and analytical skills.

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication.

* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.



## What Makes This Project Unique



This is more than a standard VA position. We are building a long-term Amazon FBA business focused on sustainable growth, high account health, and operational excellence. You will be expected to think critically, identify profitable opportunities, and proactively recommend improvements rather than simply completing assigned tasks. We value initiative, honesty, accuracy, and continuous learning.



## About Our Business



We are a growing Amazon FBA business focused on building a scalable and profitable e-commerce operation. Our goal is to source high-quality products, maintain excellent customer satisfaction, and operate in full compliance with Amazon's policies. We believe in long-term partnerships with tea
mbers who are reliable, trustworthy, and committed to excellence. If you are passionate about Amazon FBA and enjoy helping businesses grow, we would love to work with you.

We're looking for someone who:



* Has excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and communication skills.

* Learns quickly and enjoys mastering new systems and processes.

* Is proactive and takes initiative instead of waiting to be told what to do.

* Can work independently with minimal supervision.

* Is resourceful and knows how to find answers before asking for help.

* Accepts feedback professionally and applies it immediately.

* Is adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where processes continue to improve.

* Is willing to unlearn habits from previous companies and fully adopt our workflows, SOPs, and standards.

* Takes pride in producing high-quality work instead of simply completing a shift.

* Is looking for a long-term opportunity rather than just another VA job.



We believe skills can be taught. A strong work ethic and great attitude are much harder to teach.



Preferred Experience



Experience in the following is a plus:



* Shopify

* Loop Subscriptions

* Checkout Champ

* Ecommerce Customer Cupport

* Subscription-based businesses

* Gorgias, Commslayer, Richpanel, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Front, or similar helpdesk platforms



If you don't have experience with every tool listed above, that's okay. We provide training for the right candidate.



Responsibilities



You'll be responsible for:



* Responding to customer
s professionally and empathetically.

* Resolving customer concerns efficiently.

* Handling order updates, shipping inquiries, refunds, replacements, subscriptions, and product questions.

* Following company SOPs while adapting to new processes as the business grows.

* Delivering a consistently excellent customer experience.



Compensation & Growth



* Starting rate: $4 USD/hour

* New hires will begin on a part-time trial period

* High-performing tea
mbers who consistently demonstrate reliability, initiative, and strong performance will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time position (40-48 hours/week)

* Performance bonuses and opportunities for career growth as the company continues to expand.



We're looking for someone who wants to grow with the company. 

Preference will be given to applicants who are able to make our team their primary work commitment.





Our Hiring Process



We invest heavily in building a strong team, so our hiring process is designed to identify candidates who are willing to learn and grow.



1. Submit your application.

2. Selected applicants will receive a short application form.

3. Top candidates will be invited for an interview.

4. Successful interviewees will receive access to our learning materials for a self-paced learning period (approximately one week).

5. Before the end of that week, you'll complete a timed mock customer support assessment based on the materials provided.

6. Candidates who successfully pass the assessment will proceed to paid training stage, with the opportunity to become a long-ter
mber of our team.



Please note: The evaluation stage is designed to assess your ability to learn, follow SOPs, and apply new knowledge. 

Only candidates who successfully pass this stage will move on to paid training.



Requirements



* At least 18 years old.

* Fluent in written English.

* Strong grammar and communication skills.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Able to work independently.

* Eager to learn and continuously improve.

* Ecommerce customer service experience is preferred but not required.





How to Apply

To confirm you've read this entire job post, please:



1. Include the word Blue at the beginning of your application title.



2. Answer the following questions:



* What motivates you to do great work?

* Why do you want to work with our company?

* Tell us about a time you had to learn something completely new. How did you approach it?

* What do you believe makes excellent customer service?

* How do you usually handle constructive feedback?

* If you don't know the answer to a customer's question, what would you do?



3. Bonus Exercise

A customer sends the following
:



"I've already
ed twice and nobody has helped me. This is honestly very frustrating."



Write the response you would send to this customer.



We carefully review every application. 



Thoughtful answers matter much more than generic responses or years of experience.

title: Editorial Content Designer (Freelance | Remote)
description:
We're looking for a freelance Editorial Content Designer to help shape the visual storytelling of Of The Motherland (OTM).



This role is for someone with a strong design eye who enjoys creating thoughtful, editorial-style content. You'll receive creative direction, copy, and assets—we're looking for someone who can bring those ideas to life through beautiful design.



This is a design role, not a social media management role.



## About OTM



Of The Motherland (OTM) is a discovery platform and growing ecosystem connecting people with African brands through storytelling, curated experiences, and thoughtful design.



We're inspired by brands and publications like:



- Fifty Four Magazine

- Irin Journal

- Marmalade Collective

- Gather Market



You don't need experience with African fashion or culture—we're looking for someone whose design style aligns with our aesthetic.



## What You'll Do



- Design Instagram carousels

- Edit simple Reels

- Design Instagram Stories

- Maintain a cohesive visual identity across our content

- Occasionally design assets for presentations, campaigns, or brand materials



You'll primarily be executing creative direction rather than developing content strategy.



## What We Provide



You'll receive:



- Creative briefs

- Copy

- Images and videos

- Design references

- Feedback and revisions



Your role is to transform those into polished, on-brand content.



Approximately 70% of the creative direction will already be established.



## Workload



- Approximately 12 pieces of content per month across feed posts, Reels, and Stories

- Mostly batch-created

- Occasional ad hoc design requests



If we're a great fit, there will be opportunities to support additional brands and projects within our company.



## We're Looking For Someone Who...



- Has a clean, modern design style

- Understands typography, layout, and visual hierarchy

- Appreciates editorial design

- Has excellent attention to detail

- Takes feedback well

- Works independently and communicates clearly

- Meets deadlines consistently



Experience with Canva is required. Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, or InDesign) is a plus.



## Our Design Philosophy



We're building recurring editorial series that people instantly recognize—not trend-driven social media graphics.



Consistency, restraint, and thoughtful design matter more to us than flashy effects.



If your work feels at home alongside publications like Fifty Four Magazine or Irin Journal, we'd love to hear from you.



## Paid Trial



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid trial project.



We'll provide an existing Instagram carousel from one of our recurring series (In the Loop) and ask you to improve it while staying true to our creative direction.



We're not looking for a complete redesign—we want to see how you think, refine, and elevate an existing concept.



## To Apply



Please send:



- Your portfolio

- 3–5 pieces you're most proud of

- Your preferred rate (hourly or per project)

- Your monthly availability



To confirm you've read the full description, begin your application with the word:



'LOOP'

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Position Overview:



As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.





Pay Range: $8 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.





About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission.





Objectives:

• Manage and organize the CEO's daily schedule, including meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.

• Act as a gatekeeper, screening and prioritizing communications to the CEO.

• Coordinate and facilitate communication between the CEO and internal/external stakeholders.

• Anticipate the CEO's needs and proactively handle tasks to ensure optimal time management.

• Coordinate special projects and initiatives as assigned by the CEO.





Competencies:

• Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with keen attention to detail.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion in handling sensitive information.

• Proficient in using Microsoft Office and Google Suites.

• Familiarity with scheduling software; experience with additional productivity tools is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.





Equipment Requirements:

• Must own a reliable computer or laptop capable of handling administrative tasks efficiently.

• Must own and actively use an iPhone and/or MacBook or Mac computer for efficient communication and task management.

• High-speed internet connection to support video calls, cloud-based collaboration, and remote work.





Physical Requirements:

• Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.



Benefits:

• Growth opportunities in a well-established company.

• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

• Opportunity for advancement within the company.

• A supportive and collaborative work environment.

• Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time).

• Paid vacation.





How to Apply:



If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its tea
mbers and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.




/internationalcareers



Power Plus Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds to apply.



Join us at Power Plus Systems, LLC, and be part of our continued success as we embark on the next 20 years of excellence in residential electrical contracting!

title: Finance Administrator
description:
Position Overview



Paula seeks a detail-oriented and organized Finance Administrator to join our

operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing our financial operations,

including billing submissions, accounts receivable management, and overall financial

compliance. You will ensure accurate and timely Medicaid submissions, track payment

processing, resolve billing discrepancies, and maintain our QuickBooks accounting system. This

position is critical to maintaining the financial health and regulatory compliance of our

organization.



Key Responsibilities



Billing Submissions & Processing

• Prepare and submit billing claims to Medicaid in a timely and accurate manner

• Review billing documentation for completeness and compliance

• Maintain records of all submissions and track claim status

• Identify and correct billing errors before submission to prevent claim denials

• Ensure compliance with Medicaid billing guidelines and requirements



Accounts Receivable Management

• Monitor outstanding accounts receivable and aging reports

• Follow up on unpaid invoices and claims according to established timelines

• Contact Medicaid and other payers to investigate and resolve payment delays

• Document all follow-up communications and maintain detailed records

• Provide regular reporting on receivables status to management



Payment Processing & Issue Resolution

• Track and reconcile incoming payments from all sources

• Investigate discrepancies, denials, and payment issues promptly

• Communicate with payers and internal teams to resolve billing problems

• Ensure all payments are properly recorded and allocated to appropriate accounts

• Work diligently to resolve issues within the required timeframes



QuickBooks Management

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date QuickBooks records

• Record all financial transactions with proper coding and documentation

• Generate financial reports and statements as needed

• Reconcile accounts on a regular basis

• Ensure compliance with accounting standards and best practices



General Financial Duties

• Prepare and maintain billing logs and financial documentation

• Support month-end and year-end closing processes

• Assist with audit preparation and documentation

• Participate in process improvements to enhance billing efficiency and accuracy



Required Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Minimum 2 years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, or general accounting

• Proven experience with Medicaid billing processes and requirements

• Proficiency with QuickBooks or similar accounting software

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

• Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines

• Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team



Preferred Qualifications

• Associate’s degree in accounting or finance

• Experience in home health or home care billing

• Knowledge of healthcare compliance regulations

• Experience with multiple payer systems

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and data management tools

• Experience with AxisCare or similar home care management systems



Required Skills & Competencies

Attention to Detail – Accuracy in financial records and claim submissions is essential for

Organizational success and regulatory compliance.



Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills – Ability to investigate and resolve complex billing

issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions.



Time Management – Ability to prioritize tasks, manage competing deadlines, and ensure

timely completion of critical financial processes



Reliability and Accountability – Responsible for managing critical financial processes and

Ensuring accuracy in all work.



Communication Skills – Ability to interact professionally and effectively with payers, internal

staff, and management; clear documentation of all interactions.



Technical Proficiency – Comfortable working with accounting software, spreadsheets, and

multiple computer systems



Work Environment



This position is based in our office and will primarily involve computer-based work, including

data entry, claim submission, and financial reporting. The role may require occasional

communication with external agencies and payers. This position is full-time; hours are

Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., with some flexibility as needed to meet deadlines.



Equal Opportunity Statement

Paula is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive

workplace and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age,

disability, or any other protected characteristic.



How to Apply:

Interested candidates should submit a resume and cover letter to

Part-time to start, flexible hours — expect roughly [5-8 hours/week — fill in based on your current backlog]

How to apply



 me at 
 with you resumee and please include:

title: Architectural Precast Estimator/detailer
description:
Architectural Precast Estimator & Detailer



Position Summary  

The Architectural Precast Estimator & Detailer is responsible for reviewing construction documents, performing quantity takeoffs, preparing project estimates and proposals, and producing detailed drafting and shop drawings for architectural precast, GFRC, UHPC, and custom concrete projects. This role works closely with contractors, architects, engineers, project managers, and fabrication teams to support preconstruction and project execution.



Key Responsibilities

- Review architectural and structural drawings, specifications, and bid documents

- Perform accurate quantity takeoffs and material calculations using PlanSwift and related estimating software

- Prepare detailed cost estimates, budgets, and bid proposals

- Generate and coordinate shop drawings, fabrication details, and layout drawings

- Create CAD drafting and detailing packages for production and installation

- Coordinate with architects, engineers, contractors, and internal teams regarding design and technical requirements

- Assist with project development, lead follow-up, and client communication

- Identify scope gaps, RFIs, and potential value engineering opportunities

- Support production and field teams with drawing revisions and technical clarification

- Maintain organized project files, estimates, revisions, and correspondence

- Assist with scheduling and preconstruction coordination



Qualifications

- Experience in precast concrete, GFRC, UHPC, stone, or construction estimating/detailing

- Proficiency in PlanSwift for digital takeoffs and estimating

- Ability to read and interpret architectural and structural plans

- Proficiency in AutoCAD, Bluebeam, or similar drafting/estimating software

- Strong understanding of construction methods and materials

- Excellent communication and organizational skills

- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

- Knowledge of fabrication and installation processes is preferred



Preferred Skills

- Experience with architectural precast systems and custom concrete fabrication

- Knowledge of shop drawing standards and production detailing

- Understanding of estimating software and bid preparation

- Ability to coordinate directly with clients and project teams

- Strong problem-solving and technical coordination abilities

title: Growth Marketing Manager (E-commerce | B2B & B2C)
description:
Work Type: Remote

Schedule: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Time Zone: Must work during US Pacific Time business hours

________________________________________

About the Role



Metpure Inc. is a U.S.-based company specializing in water filtration and plumbing supplies, serving both business customers and consumers through multiple e-commerce channels.



We're NOT looking for someone to simply manage marketing channels. We're looking for someone who can identify growth opportunities, develop creative campaign strategies, coordinate execution across our marketing team, and use data to continuously improve results.



This is not a marketing execution role. We already have a graphic designer, web developer, paid advertising specialist, and social media content creator. Your role is to lead the strategy behind our marketing efforts and coordinate the team to bring campaigns to life.



You'll identify marketing opportunities, develop compelling campaign ideas, understand customer behavior, interpret marketing data, and continuously improve performance.



You naturally see marketing opportunities everywhere. Whether it's a holiday, seasonal trend, inventory levels, customer behavior, product launches, industry events, or market trends, you immediately begin thinking, "There's a campaign here."



Success in this role comes from combining creativity, strategy, leadership, and analytics to create campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

________________________________________

What You'll Be Doing



Develop Marketing Strategy & Campaigns

• Own and maintain Metpure's annual marketing calendar.

• Continuously identify marketing opportunities using holidays, seasonal trends, customer behavior, inventory levels, product launches, industry events, and market trends.

• Develop marketing strategies for both B2B and B2C audiences.

• Create compelling campaign concepts, messaging, promotional offers, and creative marketing angles.

• Recommend promotions based on inventory levels, slow-moving products, seasonal demand, and business priorities.

• Research competitors, market trends, and customer insights to identify new growth opportunities.



Lead Campaign Execution

• Own campaigns from concept through launch.

• Coordinate campaign execution with the graphic designer, web developer, paid advertising specialist, and social media content creator.

• Develop creative briefs and campaign objectives.

• Ensure campaigns launch on schedule and achieve business goals.

• Coordinate marketing efforts across:

• Shopify website

• Landing pages

•
 marketing

• ActiveCampaign automations

• Paid advertising

• Organic social media

• Promotional pages

• B2B marketing

• B2C marketing



 Marketing & Marketing Automation

• Own and optimize ActiveCampaign marketing automation.

• Create customer segments for B2B and B2C audiences.

• Build and improve:

• Welcome sequences

• Abandoned cart campaigns

• Post-purchase follow-up

• Cross-sell and upsell campaigns

• Win-back campaigns

• Dealer onboarding

• Promotional campaigns

• Customer nurturing workflows



Customer Experience & CRO

• Continuously review the website for opportunities to improve customer experience and conversions.

• Recommend improvements to:

• Homepage

• Landing pages

• Product pages

• Navigation

• Calls-to-action

• Product messaging

• Customer journey

• Work closely with the web developer to implement improvements.



Analyze Performance & Optimize Growth

• Analyze marketing performance using:

• Google Analytics 4

• Shopify Analytics

• ActiveCampaign

• Hotjar

• Microsoft Clarity

• Meta Ads Manager

• Google Ads

• Looker Studio

• Interpret and optimize:

• Website traffic

• Click-through rates

• Conversion rates

• Heatmaps

• Session recordings

• Funnel analysis

• Customer behavior

• Audience interests

• ROAS

• Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)

• Revenue by campaign

•
 performance

• Identify opportunities for continuous improvement through testing, experimentation, and data analysis.

________________________________________

What We're Looking For

• Creative thinker who enjoys developing innovative marketing campaigns.

• Strong understanding of customer psychology and buying behavior.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Strong project management and organizational skills.

• Excellent communication and leadership skills.

• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to turn marketing data into actionable insights.

• Experience with marketing automation and customer segmentation.

• Comfortable coordinating cross-functional teams.

• Self-motivated and able to work independently.

• Experience with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms.

• Proficient with Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel.

• Reliable internet connection and professional home office.

• Available to work during US Pacific Time business hours.

________________________________________

Preferred Experience

We're interested in candidates with experience in one or more of the following:

• Growth Marketing

• E-commerce Marketing

• Marketing Strategy

• Campaign Management

• Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

• Marketing Automation

• ActiveCampaign

• Customer Journey Optimization

• Google Analytics (GA4)

• Shopify Analytics

• Hotjar

• Microsoft Clarity

• Meta Ads

• Google Ads

• Looker Studio

• A/B Testing

Experience marketing to both B2B and B2C audiences is highly preferred.

Experience in the plumbing, water filtration, construction, industrial, or home improvement industries is a plus, but not required.

________________________________________

What Success Looks Like

In this role, you'll consistently identify new growth opportunities, develop engaging marketing campaigns, coordinate successful execution across the marketing team, and use data to continuously improve results.

You'll understand the complete customer journey—from first impression through repeat purchase—and proactively recommend ideas that improve engagement, conversions, and long-term customer retention.

We value creativity, curiosity, ownership, initiative, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

________________________________________

Work Expectations

• Work during US Pacific Time business hours.

• Be responsive and available throughout your scheduled shift.

• Take ownership of Metpure's marketing strategy and campaign calendar.

• Continuously identify opportunities to grow both B2B and B2C sales.

• Coordinate projects across designers, developers, advertising, and content teams.

• Use marketing data to guide strategic decisions.

• Stay organized and communicate proactively.

• Continuously test, measure, and improve marketing performance.

________________________________________

To Apply

Please answer the following questions:

1. Tell us about your marketing experience and the types of campaigns you've managed.

2. Describe one marketing campaign you're most proud of. What made it successful?

3. Tell us about a time when marketing data changed your strategy. What did you learn, and what changes did you make?

4. Which marketing platforms and analytics tools have you used (Google Analytics, ActiveCampaign, Hotjar, Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads, etc.)?

5. Confirm that you're available to work during US Pacific Time business hours.

6. Please provide your internet speed (download/upload) and describe your home office setup.

7. Short Marketing Exercise (Required)

Visit 
 and answer the following:

• What is one thing you would improve on our website immediately?

• Describe one marketing campaign you would recommend launching within your first 30 days.

• Briefly explain why you chose that campaign and how you would measure its success.



Applications that do not follow the instructions or complete the required marketing exercise will not be considered.

title: Meta Ads Video Editor and Short Form Content Creator — Remote Position
description:
About Us:

Smart Lion Auto Detailing SEO is a growing digital marketing agency based in Texas that specializes exclusively in helping auto detailing businesses rank higher on Google, generate more leads, and grow their revenue through SEO, Google Ads, and Meta Ads. We work with auto detailing business owners across the United States and are actively expanding our team to support our growing client roster. We currently have one Meta Ads client and are actively growing that side of the business, with plans to expand into CTV and OTT advertising as well.



We are looking for an exceptionally talented creative video editor and content strategist to join our team long term. As we bring on more Meta Ads clients this role shifts increasingly toward Meta Ads creative production and away from general agency content. This is a role that grows with us.



About This Role:

This is a remote position working directly with the agency owner.



The agency owner handles all Meta Ads in-platform work including campaign setup, audience building, conversion tracking, optimization, and performance monitoring. In the beginning the agency owner will be actively involved in planning the video ad concepts and creative strategy alongside you. However the goal is to transition full creative ownership to you over time as you learn our clients, our standards, and our strategic approach.



That means you need to be someone who absorbs how we think about content quickly, asks the right questions early, and progressively takes over the planning and strategy role without needing to be pushed. The ideal person for this role does not wait to be told what to make. They study what is working, bring fresh concepts proactively, write the production briefs independently, and present a complete monthly content plan without being asked.

You will be responsible for two distinct types of work.



Your primary responsibility and highest priority is producing high quality Meta Ads video content for our clients. This includes writing complete creative briefs that tell the client exactly what to film, planning TOFU MOFU BOFU content strategy, editing polished finished videos optimized for Meta Ads performance, and proactively coming up with fresh creative concepts that generate leads.



Your secondary responsibility is producing consistent short form and long form video content across three brands — Smart Lion Auto Detailing SEO, Smart Lion Law Firm SEO, and Alpha Lion Auto Detailing. This content is quicker turnaround and less production heavy but needs to be consistently engaging and on brand.



This role is NOT heavily structured or instruction dependent. We need someone who is genuinely creative, proactive, and capable of bringing strong ideas to the table independently. You will be given direction and examples but we expect you to run with concepts creatively and come back with work that exceeds expectations — not someone who needs hand holding on every single edit.



As the agency grows and we bring on more Meta Ads clients the social content work decreases and Meta Ads creative production becomes the full focus of this role.

If you are someone who thrives with creative autonomy, takes initiative, and wants to own a creative department rather than just execute tasks — this role is built for you.



What You Will Be Doing:

The tasks listed below are examples of the type of work involved in this role. This is not an exhaustive list. Expect the actual scope to grow as the agency and client roster expands.

Meta Ads Creative — Primary Priority:



-Writing complete production ready creative briefs for clients covering exactly what to film, how to film it, what to say, and what b-roll to capture



-Planning monthly TOFU MOFU BOFU content strategy — two top of funnel, two middle of funnel, two bottom of funnel videos always running simultaneously per client



-Editing fully produced Meta Ads videos optimized for lead generation — hooks, pacing, graphics, music, captions, and calls to action



-Coming up with fresh creative concepts independently between brief cycles so new ad creative is always ready before underperforming ads need to be replaced



-Adapting content for YouTube Shorts and long form YouTube as needed



-Assisting with CTV and OTT video ad creation as the agency expands into connected TV and streaming advertising — this will become an increasing part of the role over time



Short Form and Long Form Social Content — Secondary:



-Editing quick turnaround short form videos for Smart Lion Auto Detailing SEO, Smart Lion Law Firm SEO, and Alpha Lion Auto Detailing



-Producing long form YouTube videos including scripting assistance, editing, thumbnails, and optimization for YouTube SEO

Adding captions, music, graphics, and text overlays to raw talking head footage



-Keeping all three brands consistently active on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and YouTube long form

Approximately twelve to sixteen short form videos per month per brand





What We Are Looking For:



Exceptional short form and long form video editing skills — you must be able to produce content that stops the scroll and holds attention from first frame to last



Deep understanding of what makes video ads convert — hooks, pacing, emotional triggers, social proof, and strong calls to action



Ability to write complete professional creative briefs that guide non-professional clients on exactly what to film



Strong understanding of TOFU MOFU BOFU content strategy and how to build a full funnel content plan for a Meta Ads account



Proficiency in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve — tell us which you use best



Deep understanding of virality best practices — hooks, pattern interrupts, retention tactics, and platform specific optimization for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube



Extremely creative and proactive — you bring ideas to the table, you do not wait to be told what to make



Open to feedback and revisions — you take direction well and implement edits quickly without ego



Strong communicator — available and responsive on Slack during Central Standard Time business hours immediately when messaged



Reliable and consistent — you hit deadlines every time without being chased



Long term mindset — we are building something and we want you to grow with us





Nice to Have:



Meta Ads Manager experience — running campaigns, building audiences, setting up conversion tracking, and optimizing performance



Experience creating content specifically for auto detailing, home services, or local service businesses



Experience creating lead generation video ads for local service businesses



YouTube long form video production experience including editing, thumbnail creation, and YouTube SEO optimization



CTV and OTT video ad experience or familiarity with connected TV and streaming ad formats and specs

Motion graphics or animation skills





What We Offer:



Stable long term remote position with consistent monthly income of $800 to $1,200 per month based on experience and deliverables



Direct working relationship with an experienced agency owner who values creativity and initiative



A role that grows in responsibility and compensation as the agency and client roster expands



Creative freedom to bring your own ideas and concepts — we want your creativity not just your execution



A respectful professional environment where great work is recognized and rewarded



Performance based raise after 90 days for tea
mbers who consistently deliver exceptional work





Availability Requirement — Non Negotiable:

This role requires immediate availability and responsiveness during Central Standard Time business hours. You must be available on Slack within minutes of being messaged during CST working hours. Our clients move fast and we need our team to move just as fast. If you cannot genuinely accommodate CST working hours please do not apply.



How to Apply:

Please send a message including all of the following. Applications missing any item will not be considered.



-A two to three minute video introduction of yourself telling us who you are, your experience in video editing and content creation, and why you are the right fit for this role. Upload to YouTube or Google Drive and include the link. This is required — no video means no review.



-Your portfolio showing examples of your video editing work across any combination of the following — short form Reels and TikToks, Meta Ads creative, and long form YouTube content. This is required — no portfolio means no review.



-The editing software you use and your experience level with it



-Your honest assessment of your strongest creative skill — editing, concept development, brief writing, or strategy



-Confirmation that you are available and responsive during Central Standard Time business hours and how you currently accommodate US client schedules



-Your monthly rate expectation



Smart Lion Auto Detailing SEO looks forward to finding the right long term creative partner to grow with us.
