title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location:  Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: Early August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. This hands-on role is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, preparing timely management information, and ensuring finance workflows operate efficiently and reliably.



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:00 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:00 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities and the successful candidate’s capability and availability.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

•  Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: E-commerce Growth Marketer
description:
We're a holding company growing a portfolio of ecommerce brands. We buy good businesses and scale them with strong systems and sharp marketing. We're hiring our first dedicated growth hire to own the day-to-day across two brands, with a clear path to running growth for an eight-figure operation as the portfolio grows.



This is not a campaign-coordinator seat and it's not a narrow specialist lane. This is a growth role. You look at the numbers, figure out which step of the funnel is broken, and go build the fix. Some days that's a new batch of
 ads. Some days it's a new
 flow or a fresh offer. You own the whole loop: diagnose, build, ship, measure, repeat.



The person who thrives here is a self-learner who teaches themselves new tools before anyone asks, thinks in offers and funnels, and wants real ownership instead of a to-do list. If that's you, keep reading.



The core of the job



You'll run this loop every week, across both brands:



Read the numbers and find the broken step. You live in the data. You know whether this week's problem is an acquisition problem (traffic, creative, conversion rate, AOV) or a retention problem (repeat rate,
 and SMS revenue, flow performance, churn). You diagnose before you build.



Build the fix. Once you know what's broken, you go make the thing that fixes it. You are hands-on and in the tools every day. This is a build role, not a delegate-everything role.



What you'll own



Acquisition creative. You own the creative pipeline for paid social, 15-20 new pieces per week. You write the creative briefs, you write the ad copy, and you use our AI tools to build the ads themselves. You hand final design polish to our designer and coordinate with our media buyer on what to test and scale, but the concepts, the copy, and the builds come from you. You're the engine.



 and SMS. You own Klaviyo strategy across both brands. You design the offers and flows, write the campaign copy, and deliver a monthly campaign calendar. You direct a contractor to execute the technical build in Klaviyo, but the strategy, the offers, and the words are yours.



Offers and funnels. This is the heart of the role. You're the person who looks at a product and knows what offer will make a customer buy and what path will get them there. Everything else is in service of this.



AI systems. You use our AI systems to move fast, and you make them better over time. You build workflows and automations so the whole operation gets lighter and faster every quarter.



The weekly report. You run the weekly performance reporting system and deliver one clear report to the founder every week: what you built, what shipped, what moved. We work through every open issue together in that meeting, then you go execute.



Whatever moves the number. Smaller tasks come up. You stay flexible.



The team around you



You're the first growth hire, but you're not alone. You'll coordinate with a designer, and a media buyer. Your job is to be the brain that directs that work and does the core building yourself. You are the glue between the idea and the shipped result.



How we measure success



You'll know exactly what winning looks like:



Creative volume: 15-20 new pieces per week, briefed, written, and built by you.

Scaling: grow spend roughly 10-15% per week while holding MER targets.

 and SMS: at least 25% of revenue on each brand, with deliverability held at 75 or above.

Brand performance: protect MER targets as we scale.

Systems: AI workflows and automations that make all of the above faster every quarter.

The weekly loop: one clear report every week, delivered to the founder. We surface every open issue, work through it live, and you go execute.

You're a fit if you have



A real instinct for offers and funnels. You understand why customers buy and how to structure the path that converts them. This is the one thing we can't teach, so it matters most.

Sharp copywriting. You can write an ad and an
 that sells.

Hands-on command of AI content and AI video tools. You build with them daily.

Real Klaviyo experience, hands in the account, not just oversight.

Comfort living in the numbers and making the call on what to build next.

Shopify experience.

Early in your career is fine. Hungry and self-taught beats credentialed and passive. We care about how you think and what you've actually moved.



The growth path



This starts as a hands-on execution and strategy role and grows into full growth leadership as we add brands. We're looking for someone who wants that seat and is willing to earn it.



Record a quick Loom: Introduce yourself, then answer these four questions:



1. Tell us about one brand you grew. What was your exact role, and what was the result? 



2. If you were handed a product doing $50k a month and asked to double it, what's the first thing you'd look at, and why? 



3. Walk us through the core Klaviyo flows you'd want live on a DTC brand, and the offer you'd put in each one. Why those offers? 



4. Walk us through one ad or campaign you built using AI tools. What did you make, which tools, and how did it perform?

title: Sales Operations Project Manager
description:
We’re looking for a strong, proactive Sales Operations Project Manager who can lead a sales pod, drive accountability across closers and setters, and maintain seamless communication between Sales, Growth Ops, and Tech Ops.



This is a leadership and coordination role — you are the operational backbone that ensures the pod performs at a high level, SOPs are followed, data is accurate, and every tea
mber stays aligned and supported. If you’re the kind of person who naturally takes ownership, thrives in fast-paced environments, and knows how to communicate with clarity and authority, you’ll excel here.



This is a full-time position, requiring consistent availability from 8am to 4pm Eastern Time, with solid internet, power, and backup.



All applicants must complete DISC and IQ assessments before applying.



Detailed Job Description Breakdown



Pod Leadership & Daily Operations

• Lead and manage the daily workflow of closers and setters to ensure the sales pod operates smoothly.

• Run daily huddles, weekly check-ins, and pipeline reviews with clear agendas and follow-through.

• Manage pod-level projects (e.g., SOP rollouts, funnel changes, tracking fixes) end-to-end, ensuring on-time execution.

• Monitor pod performance, identify bottlenecks early, and escalate issues with solutions—not problems.

• Own the onboarding and offboarding process for new sales staff, including systems access, SOP orientation, and performance expectations.

• Ensure all pod members maintain clean calendars, proper availability, and updated CRM/task workflows.



Quality Assurance, Accountability & Compliance

• Hold closers and setters accountable for submitting accurate EODs, updating dispositions, and following SOPs consistently.

• Conduct quality checks on sales calls, calendar availability, CRM hygiene, and follow-up sequences.

• Audit all sales data regularly (bookings, show rates, sales, payments, renewals) to ensure accuracy before reporting.

• Flag performance gaps early and coach tea
mbers with clarity, empathy, and firmness.

• Ensure all pod documentation, scorecards, and checklists are consistently maintained and up to date.



Cross-Department Coordination

• Work directly with Front-End Tech Ops, Back-End Automation Specialists, and Growth Ops to resolve tech issues, data discrepancies, or workflow breakdowns.

• Communicate updates clearly and quickly across all stakeholders — closers, setters, Growth Ops, SOMs, Tech Ops, and leadership.

• Serve as the bridge for multi-team projects (automation fixes, tracking repairs, new funnels, offer migrations).

• Maintain a strong working relationship with salespeople (who may be impatient or stressed under pressure) while keeping communication tight, professional, and steady.



Reporting & Performance Management

• Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports for leadership, ensuring all numbers are accurate and validated.

• Track KPIs across the full funnel: leads ? setters ? calls ? sales ? renewals.

• Support leadership in evaluating pod performance, identifying improvement plans, and implementing corrective action.

• Ensure the sales pod meets revenue, activity, and quality targets consistently.



Skills & Qualifications

• Project Management experience is mandatory.

(Comfortable managing timelines, action items, dependencies, and follow-through across multiple teams.)

• At least 1–2 years experience in sales operations, sales admin, sales coordination, or a similar leadership/ops role.

• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills — able to hold people accountable with firmness and empathy.

• Excellent verbal and written communication; comfortable leading huddles, giving feedback, and jumping on calls.

• Highly organized, detail-driven, and able to manage multiple moving parts in a fast-paced environment.

• Tech-savvy and comfortable navigating CRM, calendar tools, funnels, spreadsheets, and SOPs.

• Experience working with sales teams (closers/setters) is strongly preferred.

• Solution-oriented, proactive, and able to anticipate problems before they happen.

• Thrives in an environment where communication, speed, and ownership are non-negotiable.



If this sounds like you…



If you love driving clarity, supporting high-performance teams, and being the operational heartbeat of a fast-moving sales pod, we’d love to meet you. This role is perfect for someone who wants to grow into higher-level ops leadership while playing a mission-critical role in our sales organization.



About Sales Possible



At Sales Possible, we partner with mission-driven online coaching companies to build world-class marketing and sales ecosystems. We’re not just a sales team provider — we architect full-funnel systems, optimize performance, and support our clients with cutting-edge automation, AI, and operations infrastructure.



We work with high-growth education brands and expert coaches, helping them scale sustainably while delivering exceptional customer experiences.



We’re a fast-moving, tight-knit team that values ownership, proactive communication, and continuous improvement. If you want to work in an environment obsessed with growth, clarity, and performance — you’ll feel right at home here.

title: CUSTOMER SUCCESS LEAD (B2B SAAS, COMPLIANCE, ECOMMERCE) | US HOURS | G2 AWARD-WINNING US COMPANY
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

======



We’re hiring a Customer Success Lead to own post-sale customer outcomes for sales-assisted and high-value merchants.



You will help customers launch successfully, prove the system is working in production, resolve risks before they become major escalations, prepare for renewals, and expand into new states, categories, platforms, or workflows.



You’ll coordinate with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Growth. This is a player/coach role, so team guidance and process improvement may be part of the role, but direct reports are not guaranteed.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS AND IS NOT

======



This is not a basic CSM role focused mainly on check-ins and relationship maintenance.



This is not a reactive support queue role.



This role sits in the middle of customer outcomes, onboarding, compliance confidence, risk management, renewal readiness, expansion readiness, and internal coordination.



You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be comfortable using evidence, customer context, and structured follow-through to move complex accounts forward.



ABOUT TOKEN OF TRUST

======



Token of Trust helps regulated eCommerce businesses keep selling with confidence.



We help merchants launch compliant checkout, verify customers when required, reduce compliance risk, and manage the reporting and evidence they need to operate in regulated markets.



Customers have rated Token of Trust 4.9 stars on G2, and G2 recognized us among the 2026 Top 50 Data Privacy Products. We have also been recognized for Best Support, Easiest To Do Business With, High Performer, and Users Most Likely To Recommend.



Customer Success is a core part of why customers trust us. We are looking for someone who wants to help customers succeed while also improving the systems, playbooks, and processes behind that success.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

======



- Own the customer experience after sale: onboarding, launch, first proof of value, ongoing operations, renewal readiness, and expansion readiness

- Help customers launch compliant checkout with clear milestones, owners, risks, and next steps

- Help customers reach their first real proof of value in production, such as a successfully cleared customer, order, report, or compliance workflow

- Monitor customer risks such as verification issues, reporting problems, misconfiguration risk, unresolved blockers, or customer confusion

- Lead escalations by gathering evidence, isolating the problem, coordinating the right internal owners, and keeping customers updated

- Help customers understand and trust compliance calculations, reporting outputs, verification states, and operational workflows

- Prepare high-value accounts for renewal 60 to 90 days in advance by surfacing risks and driving issue-resolution plans

- Support customer expansion into new states, categories, platforms, or workflows

- Capture customer feedback clearly, ideally in the customer’s own words, and turn it into product feedback, internal tickets, or playbook improvements

- Improve onboarding playbooks, SOPs, help docs, and internal processes



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

======



You are successful when customers:



- Launch without unnecessary delays or rework

- Reach their first clear proof that Token of Trust is working for them

- Know whether their workflow is configured correctly because there is evidence, not just reassurance

- Avoid preventable surprises or unresolved escalations

- Enter renewals with known issues, owners, timelines, and a clear value story

- Feel that Token of Trust is organized, proactive, and clear



We care about support quality and customer sentiment, but this role is not measured mainly by ticket count, meeting count, logins, or generic activity metrics.



GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

======



For the right person, this is a real growth path, not just a customer-facing seat. As you prove judgement, ownership, and customer outcome discipline, you can earn more trust, broader responsibility, and increased compensation over time.



Possible growth paths include:



- Owning high-value customer onboarding and renewal readiness programs

- Building better proof-of-value playbooks for new customers

- Improving customer risk visibility and escalation prevention

- Creating customer health, renewal, and expansion workflows

- Guiding other tea
mbers through shared-account or playbook-driven Success work

- Becoming a deeper expert in regulated eCommerce customer outcomes



MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

======



- 4+ years in B2B SaaS Customer Success, Implementation, Solutions, Technical Account Management, or complex customer support

- Experience owning post-sale outcomes such as onboarding, go-live, risk management, renewal readiness, or expansion support

- Excellent written English

- Strong organization and follow-through

- Ability to manage multiple customer issues without losing details

- Good judgement in ambiguous, technical, regulated, or high-stakes situations

- Comfortable coordinating across Operations, Product, Engineering, and Growth without formal authority

- Able to diagnose issues clearly: what changed, what is the impact, what evidence exists, and what should happen next



NICE TO HAVE

======



- Experience in regulated eCommerce, identity verification, KYC, fraud, payments risk, tax, compliance reporting, or trust and safety

- Experience with Shopify, WooCommerce/WordPress, or headless eCommerce

- Basic understanding of webhooks, APIs, event logs, or technical troubleshooting

- Experience creating SOPs, playbooks, customer help docs, or internal process improvements

- Experience with shared-account or team-based customer success models



YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

======



- Like complex products where correctness and evidence matter

- Can lead escalations calmly without overpromising

- Prefer customer outcomes over activity metrics

- Enjoy improving systems, not just answering questions

- Communicate clearly with both customers and internal teams



THIS MAY NOT BE A FIT IF YOU

======



- Want a simple reactive support role

- Prefer highly defined work with little ambiguity

- Dislike cross-functional coordination

- Rely mostly on meetings, logins, or ticket counts to measure customer success

- Struggle to keep many open customer issues organized



TOOLS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT

======



We use tools such as Amplitude, internal database reporting, FreeScout, Stripe, Pipedrive, G2, Shopify/WordPress ecosystems, shared docs, issue trackers, and internal playbooks.



You do not need experience with every tool, but you must be comfortable learning new systems quickly.



The work is remote, technical, compliance-heavy, and documentation-heavy. You’ll work with Operations, Product, Engineering, and Growth.



SCHEDULE

======



- Minimum 20 hours per week required

- Opportunity to expand to full-time, 40 hours per week, based on business needs, role fit, and performance

- Remote

- Meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours required

- Please include your timezone and preferred working hours when applying



COMPENSATION

======



This role starts at approximately $300 per month for a minimum schedule of 20 hours per week.



There is an opportunity to increase both hours and earnings over time. The role may expand to full-time, and strong performers may also qualify for monthly performance incentives.



Target total monthly earnings can increase to approximately $450 to $750 per month depending on hours, performance, role scope, and business needs.



Please include your expected monthly compensation in your application.



HOW TO APPLY

======



Use this subject line:



Customer Success Lead: I help customers prove value



Please send:



1) Resume or LinkedIn profile

2) Compensation and availability

   - Expected monthly compensation

   - Timezone

   - Preferred working hours

   - Amount of overlap you can provide with U.S. business hours

3) Customer ownership story

   In 5 to 8 sentences, describe one complex customer workflow, onboarding, renewal-risk, or escalation situation you owned end-to-end. Tell us what happened, what you did, how you knew whether the customer was getting value, and what changed as a result.

4) Process improvement example

   Briefly describe one playbook, SOP, customer health process, renewal process, or internal handoff you improved.

5) Short written exercise

   A customer says:

   “We turned this on and now good customers are getting stuck. We are worried this will hurt conversion.”

   Please answer:

   - What would you say in your first customer-facing reply?

   - What information would you gather internally?

   - Who would you involve internally and why?

   - How would you keep the customer updated over the next 48 to 72 hours?

6) AI usage note

   Tell us how you used AI, if at all, to complete this application:

   - Which sections did AI help with?

   - Where did you rely on your own judgment?

   - How did you verify the final answer reflected your actual experience and thinking?



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be reviewed.



HIRING PROCESS

======



After initial application review, selected candidates may be asked to confirm role requirements, compensation fit, long-term interest, no agency or subcontracting relationship, time-tracking expectations, background-check willingness, and integrity expectations.



Finalists may be asked to complete a short intro video and a paid trial project before final interviews.

title: Ecommerce Creative or Design Director
description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We're hiring a Creative Director to own the creative performance of a fast-growing Amazon private-label portfolio. This is a marketplace-creative leadership role: main images, A+ Content, Brand Story modules, packaging, product inserts, Amazon Storefront design, lifestyle imagery, infographics, and advertising creative — the assets that win the click and close the sale on Amazon, TikTok Shop, and Shopify.

You'll lead and direct two full-time designers and partner with a branding consultant — but you won't be the one designing. Your job is to hold a high creative bar, direct the work with pointed feedback, and turn a talented-but-slow-moving team into a fluid creative engine that ships on time.

If you think in terms of Amazon listing conversion — main-image CTR, listing CVR, mobile-first PDP layout, above-the-fold storytelling, organic share — if you've owned Amazon creative for a real private-label brand, and if you're already fluent in AI-augmented design workflows, keep reading.



ABOUT US

Decolure is a US-based e-commerce company generating $18M+ annually on Amazon, with expanding presence on TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify. We operate 5 private label brands with 20+ active products across the portfolio.

What makes us different: we're building one of the most data-driven operations in the private label space. Our team uses advanced analytics, AI-powered operational agents, custom data pipelines, and structured decision frameworks to manage every aspect of the business , from keyword-level PPC decisions to inventory forecasting to competitive intelligence. This isn't a company where you'll be making gut calls. Every decision is backed by data, and every action plan has measurable outcomes.

We're a 27-person distributed team across the world. We operate in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment where ownership and accountability matter more than hours logged.



THE ROLE

As Creative Director, you'll own the performance of the design department. You report directly to the CEO and lead two full-time designers, with a branding consultant as a dotted-line partner.

The role is purely directive — running 1:1s, giving creative feedback, holding the quality bar, and driving deadlines. You'll partner closely with brand management to translate listing performance gaps into creative briefs, and work with product R&D on launch creative for new introductions.

The biggest gap on the team today is operational push — talented people, but projects drift. Your first 90 days are about taking that problem off our plate so the CEO can step out of creative reviews entirely until final approval.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Creative Leadership & Quality Bar

Own the design department — lead 1:1s with each designer, become their primary point of contact, and drive every active project to completion.

Hold a high creative standard on every Amazon deliverable — main images, A+ Content, Brand Story, packaging, inserts, Storefront, lifestyle, and infographics — by giving pointed, specific feedback, not generic critique.

Become the creative quality gate that replaces upper management. By 90 days, leadership involvement should drop to final approval only.

Audit the full creative scope in your first 30 days, identify the top gaps, and ship a prioritized improvement plan.



Amazon & Marketplace Creative Direction

Direct listing creative that converts — main images built for mobile-first CTR, A+ Content and Brand Story that lift CVR, infographics that answer buyer objections above the fold.

Translate performance data into briefs — partner with brand management to turn CTR, CVR, and organic-share gaps into specific creative briefs that fix the underlying issue, not just refresh the look.

Direct product photography and lifestyle imagery — set the shot list and art direction so studio and lifestyle assets support the listing narrative.

Extend the brand across channels — direct TikTok Shop creative and Shopify product imagery for the channel-expansion roadmap, keeping brand identity consistent with the branding consultant.

Own launch creative with product R&D — packaging, main images, and A+ for new product introductions.



AI-Augmented Creative Operations

Direct the team's AI image workflow — tool selection, prompt construction, and quality control across Midjourney, Nano Banana / Gemini Image, FLUX, or comparable tools.

Use the in-house AI image pipeline and creative priority tab to proactively find and fix underperforming creative.

Research and integrate the latest AI-design developments into the team's workflow — treat AI as leverage that expands capacity, not a threat. Headcount grows slowly because AI substantially expands output, and we want a leader who runs toward that.



Creative Operations & Delivery

Fix problems once — when the same issue appears twice, build the durable process change that prevents the third occurrence, instead of weekly triage.

Ship measurable process improvements within 60 days — lead-time targets, revision-count targets, brief quality, and review cadence.

Hit and maintain the creative KPIs — on-time delivery and low revision counts on every active project.

Run the in-house Design workspace (project boards, daily audits, briefs, creative priority tab) as your operating system — and improve the parts that aren't working.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required Experience

5–10 years in ecommerce / brand creative, with at least 2 years managing other designers. This is not a first-management role.

Hands-on Amazon private-label creative ownership — main images, A+ Content, packaging — for at least one $10M+/year private-label brand.

Proven marketplace creative fluency — you can look at an Amazon main image and articulate why it will win or lose CTR, not just whether it's pretty.

Conversion-rate mindset — you understand how listing creative drives CTR, CVR, and organic share, and you brief against those metrics.

A track record of on-time delivery with low revision counts — references on this are essential.

Expert in the core creative stack — Photoshop and Illustrator, plus active use of AI image tools. Fluent in ClickUp and Slack from day one (no ramp-up on the basics).

Active AI fluency in your daily workflow — comfort with ChatGPT, Claude, and Midjourney (or comparable AI image tools), and a history of integrating AI into a design team.

Cross-functional partnership with brand or marketing — not just receiving briefs, but co-creating them from listing performance data.



Preferred Experience

Premium bedding / home textiles or home-goods CPG creative (Decolure, Sleephoria, Bamboo Reserve, CooLinens, or comparable).

TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify creative for the channel-expansion roadmap.

Named expertise with AI image tools — Midjourney, Nano Banana / Gemini Image, FLUX — including prompt engineering.

Working knowledge of Claude specifically — our internal stack is heavily Claude-based (skills, agents, dashboards).

Experience inside an AI-agent-augmented organization with custom internal dashboards and audits.

Figma for collaboration is a plus — but this is a marketplace-creative role, not an interface-design role.



YOU ARE NOT A FIT IF

This is an Amazon private-label creative leadership role. It is not a UX/UI, web, app, SaaS, or product-design position. Please don't apply if:

Your background is primarily UX/UI, product design, or web/app interface design — screens, flows, and design systems rather than marketplace creative.

You've led design at a SaaS or software company but have never owned Amazon listing creative, A+ Content, or packaging.

Your portfolio is websites, dashboards, and mobile apps rather than main images, A+ modules, lifestyle imagery, and packaging.

You think of "conversion" only in terms of landing-page CRO, and can't speak to Amazon main-image CTR or listing CVR.

You want a hands-on individual-contributor design seat — this role directs the work, it doesn't execute it.





WHO YOU ARE

A driver, not a curator. You push projects forward instead of letting them drift. You've felt the frustration of careful leadership that ships nothing — and you don't want to be that person.

A systems thinker who fixes problems once. When you see the same issue twice, you build the durable solution that prevents the third occurrence.

A craft eye with strong opinions. You're the creative expert in the room, fluent enough in Amazon and ecommerce design to give pointed feedback and push back on weak work — not just "looks good" or "try again."

Eager to learn, not threatened. You don't need to walk in knowing our brands or stack, but you're hungry to ramp on AI tools, internal systems, and category nuance. AI is core leverage here.

A clear writer. Most coordination is async via Slack and in-app tools. You can write a brief a designer can execute without a meeting.



WHAT YOU'LL GET

Competitive salary based on experience

Fully remote position — work from anywhere with strong English fluency and overlap with US working hours

Direct access to the CEO via weekly 1:1s and ad-hoc syncs

An agent-augmented operations stack — AI-powered internal agents, custom dashboards, and in-house tooling that lets you focus on direction instead of admin

Ownership of a design department where the systems improvements you build actually stick

Opportunities for growth as the company expands into new channels and categories

A team that values durable systems, data-backed decisions, and pushing creative work forward

title: DTC Operations Lead
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a DTC Operations Lead to be the single owner of execution velocity for our Shopify direct-to-consumer channel. This is the most critical hire in our DTC buildout. We already have the strategy, the specs, the infrastructure, and the data — what we need is someone to make sure the work actually ships, every day, every week, without strategic conversations getting stuck in a document on Google Drive.

You will NOT be the person running ad accounts (that's the Growth Marketer). You will NOT be the person writing Liquid code (that's Implementation Specialist). You will NOT be the person producing creative assets (that's UGC Creators + Content Producer). Your job is to make sure ALL of those people are shipping, on-brief, on-time, every single week — and that the work they produce moves our DTC readiness score, revenue, and margin in the right direction.

This role is 70% execution management, 20% strategic decision-making, 10% hands-on analytical work. If you want to run ads or build pages yourself, this is not the right role. If you thrive on turning chaos into rhythm and watching a team ship more in a month than most DTC teams ship in a quarter, keep reading.



ABOUT US

Decolure is a US-based e-commerce company generating $18M+ annually on Amazon, with expanding presence on TikTok Shop and DTC Shopify. We operate 5 private label brands with 20+ active products across the portfolio.

What makes us different: we're building one of the most data-driven operations in the private label space. Our team uses advanced analytics, AI-powered operational agents, custom data pipelines, and structured decision frameworks to manage every aspect of the business , from keyword-level PPC decisions to inventory forecasting to competitive intelligence. This isn't a company where you'll be making gut calls. Every decision is backed by data, and every action plan has measurable outcomes.

We're a 27-person distributed team across the world. We operate in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment where ownership and accountability matter more than hours logged.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Execution Velocity & Team Management — 50% of your time

Daily standup (async or sync) with Growth Marketer, Implementation Specialist, UGC Creators — 15 minutes max, focused on "what shipped yesterday, what ships today, what's blocked"

ClickUp ownership: every open task has a clear owner, deadline, and acceptance criteria; every completed task has a tested outcome

Weekly sprint planning from the backlog of 17 existing specs + incoming priorities

Weekly sprint review: what shipped, what slipped, why, and what changes next week

Remove blockers: if Implementation Specialist is stuck on a Klaviyo flow, you unblock within 24 hours — you don't let it sit for a week

Pull from the AI agent's prioritized recommendations and assign — you should never have a tea
mber wondering what to work on

DTC Performance Accountability — 20% of your time

Own the top-line DTC KPIs: revenue, conversion rate, CAC, AOV,
 list growth, repeat purchase rate, contribution margin

Weekly performance review with the team, using data from the AI agent's dashboards

Monthly performance review with the CEO: what moved, what didn't, why, and what you're changing

Quarterly P&L review: contribution margin, LTV:CAC, channel profitability

Accountable for moving the DTC Readiness Tracker from 62% to 90% within 90 days of starting

Strategic Decision-Making — 20% of your time

D
 what the team works on this week, this month, this quarter — aligned with CEO priorities

Evaluate competing priorities: when the agent surfaces a conversion leak vs. the Growth Marketer wants to test a new creative vs. Ahmad has a blog CTA to ship, you prioritize

Approve or reject A/B test recommendations (with data justification)

Approve creative briefs before UGC creators start production

Cross-channel coordination: when Amazon runs a promotion, you d
 DTC's response; when TikTok wants to test a creator, you validate the DTC implications

Escalate to CEO only what requires CEO-level decisions (budget above $500/day, pricing changes, strategic shifts) — you handle everything else

Hands-On Analytical Work — 10% of your time

Read dashboards daily — you should know the top 5 DTC metrics before your team tasks

Read Microsoft Clarity session recordings weekly (not optional) — you should know firsthand where users get stuck on mobile

Spot-check the AI agent's recommendations — verify the logic, don't just rubber-stamp

Identify when the AI agent is missing context and feed it back (this makes the agent better over time)

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (90-DAY SCORECARD)

Month 1 — Command of the Team

Daily standup rhythm established with all tea
mbers

ClickUp fully groomed: every open task has owner, deadline, acceptance criteria

Weekly sprint + review cadence operating

All 17 existing specs triaged and prioritized into a 12-week roadmap

First 5 specs shipped to production (not just drafted — LIVE)

You can verbally walk the CEO through current DTC performance, top risks, and this week's priorities in 5 minutes without notes

Month 2 — Execution at Pace

At least 10 specs shipped to production (cumulative from month 1)

DTC Readiness Tracker moved from 62% to 72%+

Store-wide conversion rate improved 0.2pp+ from baseline

Meta ROAS above 1.5x sustained

 list growth accelerating (measurable WoW)

Zero specs older than 30 days sitting "in progress" — everything moves or gets killed

Month 3 — DTC Revenue Inflection

DTC revenue trajectory toward $30K+/month

DTC Readiness Tracker at 85%+

Blended ROAS above 2x sustained

CAC trending toward $15 target

Team is operating without needing daily direction — sprint cadence is self-sustaining

Clear strategic plan for months 4-6 submitted to CEO



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Must-Have Experience (Non-Negotiable):

4+ years leading DTC e-commerce operations (Shopify, BigCommerce, or direct Shopify Plus) at a brand doing $500K-$10M/year

Demonstrable track record of running a cross-functional DTC team: paid media, CRO,
, content, implementation

Experience managing remote teams across time zones (you will manage people in 2-4 countries simultaneously)

Project management fluency: ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Linear, Monday — doesn't matter which, but you must have run a real backlog, not a checklist

Data literacy: you can read GA4, Shopify Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Klaviyo, and Search Console fluently — not an expert in each, but competent enough to verify a specialist's work

Strong communication: written (async updates, briefs, escalation
s) and verbal (CEO check-ins, team standups)

Fluent English: written and verbal — this is a CEO-facing and team-leadership role

Strong Preferences:

Experience at a company running DTC alongside Amazon (cross-channel dynamics are a daily reality here)

Experience with bedding, home, wellness, or premium lifestyle brands

Experience working with AI tools as part of daily workflow (not just "used ChatGPT a few times")

Shopify Plus admin experience (not required, but a plus)

Klaviyo, Microsoft Clarity, 
, Gorgias, or similar tool fluency

Nice-to-Have:

Background as a former Growth Marketer or CRO specialist (you understand what your team is doing at a technical level)

Experience in a 5-10 person company (you understand scrappy execution, not Fortune 500 bureaucracy)

Experience building or scaling a DTC channel from

We are Drippl, a performance marketing agency based in Warsaw, Poland. We manage Meta advertising for around 15 DTC (direct-to-consumer) brands across Scandinavia. We are growing fast and need an extra pair of hands to handle the launching side of our operations.

Creatives (video and static)

Ad copy and primary text

Update trackers and dashboards in Google Sheets and Notion as you launch

Communicate launches in Slack with the relevant tea
mbers

Detail-oriented. We expect zero typos in ad names, no wrong budgets, no mismatched audiences

???? Why Join Skinnify?

???? Real Career Growth – Your trajectory here is whatever you make of it. One tea
mber went from Video Editor to Creative Strategist and doubled their salary. Another started in Customer Support and now manages the entire Customer Support department. We promote from within and invest in people who want to grow.

Our founder Christian grew up in Frankfurt, Germany. Looking around, he noticed something striking: so many of the women in his life — his mom, his sister, his friends — wanted to get fitter, lose weight, and build muscle, but kept running into the same wall. title: Voice AI Engineer
description:

From day one, you'll work on real projects with real clients — not practice exercises. You'll also be joining our existing team in the Philippines, so you'll have teammates and support as you ramp up.



The technical work is very learnable. So we're optimizing for two things: a genuine technical/analytical mind, and outstanding English. You'll be building, testing, and improving AI agents that interact with real people, so clear, confident communication matters as much as your problem-solving.



This role is for you if you want:

- To learn fast — we invest in training, and you'll build real, in-demand AI skills

- A degree in Computer Science, Math, Engineering, or a related quantitative field

- Graduated from a top Philippine university (UP, Ateneo, De La Salle, UST — or tell us where you studied and why you're exceptional)

- Excellent spoken and written English — you can hold a natural conversation and write clearly

- Strong asynchronous communication skills — you write clearly, keep your team updated, and can work independently across time zones

- Comfort with logic, problem-solving, and figuring out new tools from documentation



How we work:

- No graveyard shifts — we work in reasonable, humane hours and rely on strong async communication rather than forcing you onto US overnight time

- A supportive team already on the ground in the Philippines that you'll be part of

title: Senior Mortgage Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a full-time Senior Mortgage Operations Virtual Assistant to support the front end of the residential loan pipeline.



This role is focused on four key areas: borrower intake, document collection and verification, Floify file management, and pipeline tracking.



The ideal candidate has prior mortgage operations experience, strong attention to detail, clear communication skills, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.



This is not a general admin role. We are looking for someone who understands mortgage documentation, borrower communication, and the importance of keeping loan files organized, accurate, and updated.



Work Schedule

Full-time position

Monday to Friday

9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time

160 hours per month



Candidates must be able to work during Eastern business hours in real time.



Rate

$8 to $10 per hour, depending on experience and skill level.



Candidates with stronger mortgage operations experience, strong tool familiarity, and proven ability to work independently will be considered at the higher end of the range.



Main Responsibilities

1. Borrower Intake

The VA will help manage the first stage of the borrower process and make sure new leads are handled properly and on time.



Tasks include:

Acknowledge new leads promptly

Make initial borrower contact during business hours

Collect and confirm borrower information

Gather 1003 application details

Open and organize the borrower file

Set up borrower information in Floify

Explain the document process, next steps, and basic timeline to borrowers

Make sure borrower communication is clear, professional, and timely



2. Document Collection and Verification

The VA will be responsible for helping collect borrower documents and checking that files are complete, clear, and properly organized.



Tasks include:



Send initial document request lists to borrowers

Follow up on missing documents

Review uploaded documents for completeness

Check for missing pages, expired documents, unclear scans, or inconsistent information

Flag issues or discrepancies for the team

Make sure required borrower documents are collected and organized

Apply the correct file naming format

Keep documentation clean, accurate, and easy to review



3. Floify File Management

The VA will maintain borrower files inside Floify and make sure each workspace is updated and borrower-ready.



Tasks include:



Create and maintain borrower workspaces in Floify

Build and update document needs lists

Send and update document requests

Monitor document uploads

Update milestones and file status

Keep the borrower portal organized

Make sure all borrower-facing communication inside the system is professional and current

Maintain clean and accurate file records



4. Pipeline Tracking

The VA will help keep the loan pipeline updated so the team can clearly see the status of each active file.



Tasks include:



Update the pipeline board daily

Track each file by stage, next action, and aging

Identify stalled files or delayed borrower responses

Follow up before files become delayed

Provide a clear daily status view of active intake and documentation files

Make sure the team knows what needs attention each day



Required Experience and Skills

The ideal candidate should have:



At least 2 years of experience in mortgage operations, loan processing support, or loan officer support

Experience with U.S. residential lending is strongly preferred

Familiarity with the 1003 application

Understanding of common mortgage documents, including income, asset, credit, and identity documents

Experience reviewing documents for completeness and accuracy

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Strong attention to detail

Ability to follow SOPs and naming conventions

Ability to manage multiple files and deadlines

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Professional borrower communication skills

Reliable internet connection and quiet work environment



Tools and Systems

Experience with the following tools is preferred:



Floify

Calyx Point

GoHighLevel

Airtable

Notion

WhatsApp

Google Workspace

Microsoft Office



Floify and Calyx Point experience are strongly preferred. Candidates who do not have direct experience must be able to demonstrate strong mortgage operations knowledge and ability to learn quickly.



Performance Expectations

The VA should be able to support the team by maintaining strong standards in the following areas:



New leads acknowledged within the required response window

Borrower messages handled professionally and on time

Submitted documents reviewed within 24 hours

Files named and organized correctly

Pipeline updated daily

Floify workspace kept clean, current, and borrower-ready

Issues flagged early before they create delays



Assessment Requirement

Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a 3-part assessment before final selection.



The assessment will be sent once candidates are shortlisted and must be completed within the given timeframe.



The assessment includes:



Part A: Knowledge Assessment

Written mortgage fundamentals

Estimated completion time: 25 minutes



Part B: Tool Proficiency Assessment

Hands-on / practical tasks

Estimated completion time: 40 minutes



Part C: Scenario & Communication Assessment

Applied borrower situations

Estimated completion time: 25 minutes



Candidates must complete and pass all three parts to move forward in the hiring process.



Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:



Detail-oriented

Organized

Reliable

Comfortable with deadlines

Proactive in follow-ups

Clear and professional in communication

Experienced in mortgage operations

Able to manage borrower-facing tasks with care

Confident working independently

Careful with compliance boundaries



This role is best suited for a senior VA who has handled mortgage operations or loan processing support before and can help keep borrower intake, document collection, Floify files, and pipeline tracking running smoothly.





How to Apply:

Provide an updated CV together with your cover letter breaking down your relevant experience and skills that fit the role.

title: Automation Specialist — Build the Operational Backbone of a Talent Management Agency
description:
About the Project



I run a boutique talent management agency managing brand partnerships for UK reality TV and influencer talent. We handle the full lifecycle of brand deals — from first contact through to content delivery and payment.



Right now, too much of this process lives in people's heads and relies on manual follow-through. Deals stall because someone didn't chase a contract. Invoices go out late because no one flagged that content had been posted. Approvals sit in inboxes because there's no automated nudge.



I need someone to look at our deal operations workflow and build automations that make it run reliably — so the process drives itself and people are prompted to act rather than having to remember.



I'm not married to any specific platform. We currently use Protonmail, Google Drive, and WhatsApp. I'm completely open to new tools — if the right solution involves Make, n8n, Zapier, Airtable, Notion, a CRM, or something else entirely, I want your recommendation based on what actually works best.



The Workflow You're Automating



Every brand deal follows this journey. Your job is to make each transition automatic, tracked, and chased without anyone having to remember.



Stage 1 — Brand shows interest

A new contact is added to our Deals Tracker (currently Google Sheets). This should trigger the next step automatically.



Stage 2 — First response

A templated
 goes out to the brand with our rates, pitch deck, and talent suggestions. The founder is CC'd. Right now this is done manually and sometimes late.



Stage 3 — Deal confirmed

The founder confirms the deal. Once marked as confirmed in the tracker, the system should automatically generate a checklist of what's needed from the brand: campaign brief, contract, deliverables, deadlines — and request them.



Stage 4 — Admin and coordination

Documents come in from the brand. The system tracks what's been received and what's outstanding. If a brief or contract hasn't arrived within a set window, a chase goes out automatically. Everything is logged.



Stage 5 — Content coordination

Content drafts are sent to brands for approval. If approval doesn't come back within 48 hours, the system chases. Once approved, the posting date is confirmed. Once posted, the system triggers the invoicing step.



Stage 6 — Invoicing and payment

Invoice is sent when content goes live. Payment is tracked against terms. Reminders go out automatically at set intervals — 7 days before due, on the due date, 3 days overdue, 7 days overdue. I only hear about it when it hits escalation.



The Weekly Rhythm That Needs to Run Itself



Currently there's a manual weekly structure that keeps getting missed:





Monday — Review tracker, surface what needs action this week

Tuesday — Chase brands on missing briefs, contracts, approvals

Wednesday — Prompt talent coordination: insights, timelines, drafts

Thursday — Send content drafts to brands for approval

Friday — Audit invoices and payment status





I want this rhythm automated — the right notifications going to the right people on the right days, with escalation to me only when something is overdue or stuck.



What I Want From You





An honest assessment of our current tools — should we stay on Google Sheets and Protonmail, or would a different stack make this dramatically easier? I want your opinion, not just whatever works with what we have.

The automations built and tested — covering the full deal lifecycle above, with proper error handling so I know when something breaks.

Clear documentation — I need to understand what you've built well enough to maintain it or brief someone else on it. No black boxes.

A handover that actually works — walk me through it, make sure it runs, and be available for a week after handover to fix anything that surfaces in real use.





What I Don't Need





Overengineered solutions for simple problems

Anything that requires a developer to maintain long-term

Someone who builds to impress rather than to work





Budget and Timeline





Fixed project fee — please quote based on the scope above

Expected timeline: 2–4 weeks

Happy to pay properly for clean, reliable work





To Apply





Tell me what tools you'd recommend for this setup and why — based on what I've described, not what you usually default to

A screenshot or Loom of an automation you've built that involves multi-stage workflows with conditional chasing or follow-ups

One thing in the workflow above that you'd do differently — I want to know you've actually read it and thought about it

title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Senior Digital Marketing Manager (Remote)

Remote (Philippines) | Full-Time  

Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm AEST (7:00am-3:00pm PH Time) | ?70,000-?100,000/month

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Build The Marketing Engine Behind One Of Australia’s Fast-Growing Social Media Agencies



Social Status is on a mission to become Australia’s most respected social media agency.



We’re looking for an exceptional Senior Performance Marketing Manager to take ownership of our entire demand generation function and help drive the next stage of our growth.



This isn’t an agency client management role.



This isn’t a campaign execution role.



This is an opportunity to build, optimise and own the marketing systems that generate leads for our business.



We’re looking for the top 1% of marketers.



If you’re simply looking for another marketing job, this probably isn’t it.



If you’re looking for genuine ownership, autonomy and the opportunity to build something exceptional alongside an ambitious leadership team, we’d love to hear from you.



You’ll have approximately AUD $10,000 per month in advertising budget across Meta, LinkedIn and Google to drive qualified leads while taking ownership of the entire marketing funnel beyond the click.



We’re prepared to pay exceptionally well for an exceptional marketer. If you’ve consistently generated outstanding results and can prove it, we’ll happily invest in you.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



About Social Status



At Social Status, we believe social media is the most powerful marketing channel on the planet when it’s executed properly.



We partner with ambitious businesses across Australia to help them grow through strategic social media marketing, paid advertising and content creation.



As we continue to scale, we’re investing heavily in our own marketing. That’s where you come in.



You’ll work directly with the leadership team to build a world-class marketing engine that consistently generates qualified opportunities, strengthens our brand and helps us stand out in a competitive market.



You’ll have genuine ownership over strategy, execution and continuous improvement. We’re not looking for someone to maintain what’s already there. We’re looking for someone to help build what’s next.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



The Role



You’ll own our entire marketing funnel, from generating awareness through to booked sales calls.



Rather than specialising in a single channel, you’ll be responsible for ensuring every part of our marketing ecosystem works together to attract, nurture and convert high-quality leads.



You’ll have the autonomy to identify opportunities, recommend improvements, test new ideas and continually optimise performance based on data.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



What You’ll Be Doing



* Planning, building and optimising Meta, LinkedIn and Google Ads campaigns against qualified lead and cost-per-lead targets

* Managing approximately AUD $10,000 per month in advertising spend across multiple channels

* Managing
 marketing, CRM segmentation and automation inside GoHighLevel

* Building and optimising landing pages with a strong focus on conversion rate optimisation (CRO)

* Writing high-converting ad copy, landing pages,
 campaigns and other marketing assets

* Building scalable marketing systems and automations that reduce manual processes

* Monitoring campaign performance and making proactive recommendations based on data

* Producing weekly reports covering lead volume, cost per lead, conversion rates and channel performance

* Working closely with leadership to ensure every campaign aligns with our ideal client profile and commercial objectives

* Continuously identifying opportunities to improve performance across the entire marketing funnel

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



What Success Looks Like



We don’t believe in waiting 12 months to know whether a role is working.



We don’t expect perfection in your first 90 days, but we do expect 
ntum.



Within your first 90 days, we’d expect you to:



* Develop a deep understanding of our business, customers and ideal client profile

* Take ownership of our paid advertising, CRM and marketing systems

* Identify and implement meaningful improvements across our marketing funnel

* Reduce cost per qualified lead through better campaign management and optimisation

* Improve landing page conversion rates through testing and refinement

* Deliver clear reporting that helps leadership make better commercial decisions



Longer term, success means becoming the strategic owner of our entire marketing function, continuously improving lead quality, conversion rates and the systems that support our growth.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



What’s In It For You?



* ?70,000-?100,000 per month depending on experience and proven results

* Annual salary reviews based on performance

* Genuine ownership over a function being built from the ground up

* Direct access to leadership with minimal bureaucracy

* A fast-growing business where great ideas are implemented quickly

* Long-term career progression as the company continues to scale

* A collaborative team that values continuous improvement and high performance

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Who We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys solving marketing problems and improving commercial outcomes.



You’ll ideally have:



* Minimum 5 years experience managing multi-channel performance marketing campaigns with measurable commercial results

* Proven expertise across Meta Ads, Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads

* Strong experience building and optimising landing pages with a solid understanding of conversion rate optimisation (CRO)

* Excellent copywriting skills across paid ads, landing pages,
 marketing and sales funnels

* Advanced GoHighLevel knowledge, including CRM management, automations, workflows, pipelines, forms, calendars, opportunities and reporting

* Strong understanding of marketing funnels, lead generation and conversion optimisation

* Experience building sophisticated
 marketing campaigns, nurture sequences and audience segmentation

* Excellent written English with the ability to write naturally for an Australian audience

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and confidently make recommendations backed by numbers

* Experience marketing to B2B or professional service businesses

* A proactive mindset with the confidence to challenge ideas, identify opportunities and continuously improve performance



Most importantly, you’ll be someone who takes ownership. You don’t wait to be told what needs improving. You identify opportunities, present solutions and take action.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



This Role Probably Isn’t For You If…



* You prefer executing tasks rather than owning outcomes

* You’re only comfortable managing a single marketing channel

* You wait for direction instead of proactively identifying opportunities

* You’re more interested in launching campaigns than improving performance

* You enjoy maintaining the status quo more than building something better

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Why You’ll Love Working With Us



We’re building something ambitious.



Our goal is simple: become Australia’s most respected social media agency.



That means surrounding ourselves with exceptional people who care about doing great work, continually improving and helping build something they’re genuinely proud of.



We move quickly, make decisions based on data and believe the best ideas should win, regardless of where they come from. If you have a better idea, we want to hear it.



You’ll work directly with leadership, have real influence over strategy and be trusted to make meaningful decisions that shape the future of our marketing.



If you’re looking for a role where your ideas matter, your results are recognised and your career can grow alongside the business, we’d love to hear from you.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________



Interested?



Before You Apply



Please include the following with your application:



* Your resume.

* A short cover letter explaining why you’re interested in this role.

* Links to any campaigns, case studies or portfolios you’re proud of.

* Your expected monthly salary (PHP).

* Confirmation that you’re available to work Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:00pm AEST (7:00am-3:00pm PH Time).

* Confirmation that this will be your only full-time role.



We’d also like you to answer these five questions:



1. Tell us about one marketing campaign you’re most proud of. What was the objective, what did you change and what measurable results did you achieve?

2. If you joined Social Status tomorrow, what would be the first three things you’d review before making any marketing changes, and why?

3. What’s one marketing opinion or strategy you strongly believe in that many marketers disagree with?

4. Which digital marketing platforms and tools have you used extensively? Please rate your confidence out of 10 for each (Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, GoHighLevel,
 Marketing, Landing Pages/CRO and Analytics).

5. In 200 words or less, tell us why you’re the right person to build the marketing engine behind Social Status.



Applications that don’t include the above information may not be considered.



If your experience aligns with what we’re looking for, we’ll be in touch to discuss the next steps.

title: Executive Operations Specialist / AI & Automation Integrator
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly skilled Executive Operations Specialist / AI & Automation Integrator to support daily operations, improve systems, and build automation-driven workflows across a nonprofit organization and a real estate acquisition business.



This is a senior-level role for someone who can take rough, incomplete, or ambiguous instructions and turn them into clear plans, finished work, documented processes, and improved systems.



This is not a standard Executive Assistant or general Virtual Assistant role.



We are looking for someone who can think, structure, execute, verify, improve, and automate.



The right candidate must be comfortable working independently, using AI as part of their daily workflow, and building automations that reduce manual work over time.



Position Details



Role Title: Executive Operations Specialist / AI & Automation Integrator

Experience Level: Senior

Position Type: Full-time

Hours: 30 hours per week initially

Work Setup: Remote

Schedule: Async-first

Target Rate: $7 to $8 per hour, depending on experience

Start Date: Within 7 days



Work Schedule



This is an async-first role.



You can generally work when it works best for you, as long as work is completed on time, properly verified, and clearly communicated.



This is not a graveyard-shift role and does not require full US business hours.



There may be occasional brief overlap with US Eastern Time for quick coordination, phone calls, quote requests, two-factor authentication logins, or time-sensitive items.



Preferred overlap windows:



8:00 AM to 11:00 AM ET

4:00 PM to 10:00 PM ET



Output, ownership, reliability, and self-management matter more than fixed hours.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who can turn ambiguity into clarity.



You should be able to receive a rough idea, incomplete instruction, or messy operational problem and turn it into something structured, finished, verified, documented, and easier to repeat next time.



You should not need every step spelled out before you can move.



You should be able to:



Understand the goal behind the task

Create the plan

Execute the work

Verify the result

Document the process

Improve the workflow

Identify what can be automated



The goal of this role is to reduce operational load, keep work moving, and build systems that become cleaner, faster, and more automated over time.



Core Working Loop



The role follows this loop:



Create ? Execute ? Verify ? Improve ? Automate



This means you do not just complete tasks.



You are expected to make the work better each time it comes back.



If something is repeated, document it.

If something is manual, look for ways to improve it.

If something can be automated, suggest or build the automation.

If something is unclear, create structure and move it forward.



Main Responsibilities

1. Turn Ambiguous Instructions Into Clear Plans



You will often receive rough, incomplete, or high-level instructions.



Your responsibility is to turn them into clear, organized, and actionable work.



Tasks include:



Interpret unclear or incomplete instructions

Identify the real goal of the task

Make reasonable assumptions when needed

Break down messy requests into clear next steps

Create structure without waiting for every detail

Propose a path forward when something is unclear

Execute the work independently

Communicate blockers early and clearly

Provide decision-ready options when needed



You should be comfortable creating clarity instead of waiting for it.



2. Own Work From Start to Finish



You will be expected to own the full task loop, not just complete isolated steps.



Tasks include:



Take ownership of assigned work

Complete the work fully

Check and verify your own output

Open files, click links, test workflows, and confirm results before marking anything done

Follow through without needing reminders

Document what was done

Make the task easier to repeat next time

Close open loops before they become problems



When you say something is done, it should already be checked and confirmed.



3. Manage Daily Operations



You will help manage day-to-day operational work across nonprofit and real estate-related functions.



Tasks may include:



Manage tasks and workflows in Asana

Support workflows in Wrike or similar project management tools

Organize and update project boards

Track deadlines, follow-ups, and next actions

Handle invoices, receipts, and expense platforms

Support operational finance tasks

Manage documents and files

Coordinate signatures

Support calendars and inboxes

Track account portals and administrative items

Keep systems organized and current

Make sure nothing drops, stalls, or gets missed



The goal is to keep operations moving without constant check-ins.



4. Create and Improve SOPs



You will be responsible for documenting repeatable work and improving existing processes.



Tasks include:



Create SOPs for recurring tasks

Improve unclear or outdated SOPs

Document workflows clearly

Make processes easy for another person to follow

Identify friction in existing workflows

Suggest better ways to complete repeated tasks

Build systems that do not depend on memory, reminders, or constant follow-up

Prepare processes for future automation



If a task is done more than once, it should eventually become a documented process.



5. Build AI and Automation Workflows



AI-first work is required for this role.



We are looking for someone who already uses AI tools as a default part of their workflow, not someone who is only curious about AI.



You should already be using AI for:



Research

Drafting

Summarizing

Analysis

SOP creation

Problem-solving

Workflow improvement

Documentation

Data or list cleaning

Repetitive task reduction



You should also have experience building automations using tools such as:



Zapier

Make

AI workflows

Light scripting

Google Sheets automation

Apps Script

n8n or similar tools



Tasks include:



Identify repetitive manual work

Build simple and effective automations

Turn SOPs into automated workflows

Use AI to reduce time spent on repetitive tasks

Test automations before calling them complete

Document how automations work

Track what time or effort the automation saves



You must be able to share real examples of automations you have built.



6. Reduce Operational Load



A major part of this role is reducing the mental and operational load on leadership.



You should help create fewer open loops, fewer repeated questions, fewer manual steps, and fewer things that need to be chased.



Tasks include:



Surface problems early

Bring possible solutions, not just issues

Reduce unnecessary back-and-forth

Organize messy work

Keep projects moving

Create clearer systems

Improve follow-through

Help prevent last-minute operational chaos
