title: Direct Response Copywriter & Quality Lead (Remote)
description:
We’re building the future of men’s wellness in the Philippines—starting with skincare—and we’re looking for a senior direct response copywriter who can do more than write great hooks.



We’re looking for someone who can explain why copy converts, not just that it does.



The Role



As our Direct Response Copywriter & Quality Lead, you’ll be both:



A high-output writer (ads, landing pages, hook stacks, influencer briefs)

A quality gatekeeper for everything the team ships



You’ll write in Taglish and Tagalog for Filipino men aged 35–55, crafting performance-driven copy that turns cold traffic into buyers.



Every piece of copy is treated as a hypothesis. Your job is to identify what works, what doesn’t, and defend those decisions using data—not opinion.



What You’ll Do



Write ad scripts, hooks, landing pages, and influencer briefs daily

Develop new angles based on performance data and competitor insights

Review and rewrite team copy before anything goes live

Build and maintain swipe files of winning ads and hooks

Translate metrics (CTR, CPA, ROAS, hook rate) into creative decisions

Ensure every piece of copy has clear reasoning behind it



What We’re Looking For



5+ years in direct response copywriting (eCommerce/performance marketing)

Proven experience writing for Filipino audiences (Taglish/Tagalog required)

Strong understanding of hooks, persuasion, and buyer psychology

Comfortable using AI tools daily to iterate and improve copy

Experience reviewing, rewriting, and improving other writers’ work

Data-driven thinking (not “it feels right,” but “here’s why it works”)

Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced remote environment



How We Work



We don’t guess. We test.

Every hook, angle, and landing page exists for a reason—and that reason must be explainable.

If you can’t defend why a hook works, it’s not ready.

If you can’t trace a winner back to the decisions behind it, it can’t be repeated.

We hire for thinking first. Writing follows.



Details



Remote (Philippines-based team)

Salary: PHP 70,000–100,000/month (based on experience & output)

Benefits: Government-mandated (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, 13th month, leave)

Performance-based incentives available

6-month probationary period

title: Amazon Marketplace Manager | Amazon US & AU | PPC, SEO, Seller Central & Growth
description:
Amazon Marketplace Manager — Amazon US, Amazon AU & Walmart US 



Remote | Full-time or Part-time | Long-term Role | Australian Skincare Company 



We are an Australian skincare and derma-cosmetic company selling products across Amazon US, Amazon Australia and Walmart US. We are looking for an experienced Amazon Marketplace Manager to take ownership of our marketplace accounts and help improve sales, profitability and account performance. 



This is not just a PPC role. We need someone who understands the full Amazon ecosystem: listings, SEO, pricing, promotions, inventory, reporting, PPC, account health, customer service, profitability and marketplace growth. 



The successful candidate must be able to grow sales without relying only on large advertising budgets. You must be able to improve organic ranking, conversion rate, product listings, promotions, pricing, reporting and operational execution while keeping advertising spend disciplined. 



 



Main Responsibilities 



1. Amazon Account Management 



You will manage Amazon US and Amazon AU day to day, including: 

Seller Central account management  

Listing monitoring and optimisation  

Product catalogue accuracy  

Inventory and stock monitoring  

Sales and order reporting  

Account health checks  

Compliance and listing issue resolution  

Customer service queries and review monitoring  

Coordination with internal teams for product content, images, logistics and pricing  





2. Listing Optimisation & Organic Sales Growth 

You will be responsible for improving product visibility and conversion without depending only on PPC. 



Tasks include: 

Keyword research  

Search term analysis  

Title, bullet point and description optimisation  

Backend keyword updates  

Competitor listing analysis  

Category and ranking review  

Conversion rate improvement recommendations  

Image and A+ Content improvement briefs  

Monitoring 3P sellers and listing hijackers  

Identifying listing gaps, suppressed listings or ranking issues  

You must understand that Amazon growth comes from a combination of SEO, conversion, pricing, reviews, promotions, stock availability and PPC discipline. 



3. PPC & Advertising Management 



You will manage Amazon advertising with a controlled budget. 



Responsibilities include: 



Sponsored Products  

Sponsored Brands  

Sponsored Display  

Campaign structure  

Keyword harvesting  

Negative keywords  

Search term reports  

Bid optimisation  

Placement analysis  

ACoS and TACoS tracking  

ROI tracking  

Budget allocation  

Weekly PPC improvement actions  



Important: We do not want someone who only says, “increase PPC budget.” We need someone who can explain how to improve sales and profitability even with limited ad spend.  



4. Pricing, Promotions & Profitability 



You will help manage: 

Competitor pricing analysis  

Dynamic pricing recommendations  

Coupons  

Percentage-off promotions  

Subscribe & Save  

Virtual bundles  

Multiple-buy promotions  

SKU-level profitability  

Brand profitability  

Country-level profitability  

Net margin tracking  

Break-even analysis  



The goal is not just higher sales. The goal is profitable marketplace growth. 



5. Reporting & Weekly Meetings 



You will prepare weekly reports covering: 



Sales performance  

Sessions and conversion rate  

Organic ranking movement  

PPC performance  

ACoS and TACoS  

Profitability by SKU  

Inventory risks  

Account health issues  

Promotions running  

Competitor activity  

Recommended actions for the next week  



You must be comfortable working with spreadsheets, Seller Central reports and performance dashboards. 



6. Walmart US Onboarding & Marketplace Expansion 



You will also assist with Walmart US onboarding and ongoing setup, including: 

Product upload coordination  

Listing content preparation  

Marketplace setup tasks  

Issue resolution  

Pricing and catalogue checks  

Coordinating with internal teams for launch requirements  

Experience with Walmart Marketplace is preferred but not essential if you have strong Amazon experience and are willing to learn. 



Required Experience 



You must have experience with: 



Amazon Seller Central  

Amazon US marketplace  

Amazon listing optimisation  

Amazon PPC campaign management  

Keyword research and search term reports  

ACoS and TACoS reporting  

Promotions, coupons and Subscribe & Save  

Seller Central sales and inventory reports  

Competitor analysis  

Excel or Google Sheets reporting  

Experience in skincare, beauty, health, supplements or FMCG products is highly preferred. 



The Person We Are Looking For 



We are looking for someone who is: 

Commercially minded  

Detail-oriented  

Strong with numbers and reporting  

Able to identify problems before being asked  

Honest about what is working and what is not  

Able to recommend clear actions, not just provide reports  

Comfortable working independently  

Able to communicate clearly in written English  

Focused on profitability, not just sales  

Experienced enough to challenge assumptions respectfully  



 



What Success Looks Like Within the first 30–60 days, we expect you to: 



Understand our current Amazon US and AU accounts  

Identify the biggest reasons sales are not growing  

Review PPC structure and wasted spend  

Review listing SEO and conversion issues  

Identify top SKU opportunities  

Prepare a weekly marketplace growth report  

Recommend practical actions to improve sales without excessive PPC spend  

Assist with Walmart US onboarding tasks  



Within 90 days, we expect measurable improvement in: 



Listing quality  

Organic keyword ranking  

Conversion rate  

PPC efficiency  

Reporting quality  

Marketplace execution  

Profitability visibility  



 



Working Hours & Rate 



Remote role  

Philippines-based applicants preferred  

Long-term contractor position  

Estimated rate: USD in per hour depending on experience  

Part-time or full-time can be discussed  

Must be available for regular communication during agreed working hours  

Must be able to attend weekly meetings with the Australian team  



 



IMPORTANT - To Apply:



Please reply with: (This is a pre-interview questions)

 whether a keyword should be added as negative exact?
